chapters.title: Chapter 3630: Past and Present! I
paragraphs: As the weavings of an Amarantos Dream unfolded with obscurity in one region.
Across the Frequencies of Existence, other weavings manifested gloriously.
In an unknown Frequency.
Dazzling, multicolored rivers of reality swirled around a particular region, stretching outward for light-years.
At the center of these rivers stood a figure- Bob!
A placid expression filled his eyes as he toyed with a Node of Existence.
Before him hovered two dazzling Wheels of Existence, one black and one white as they were manifestations of profound power- of True Sources!
He held a sense of wonder and clarity as he gazed into the depths of these Dead True Sources.
Within their intricate design and countless spokes, one could see the weavings of entire seas of existence.
Seas of weavings.
At this moment, Bob focused on a specific subsection of the black Wheel of Existence.
Between two spokes lay a thick, dark sea- a place where the wails and screams of quintillions echoed.
These wails were drenched in pain and terror, the kind that would drive any being mad if they listened for even an hour.
And yet, Bob had listened to them endlessly, for eons.
Not just from this small subsection of the black wheel but from its vast expanse and from the white Wheel of Existence as well.
The screams of grief, indignation, fear, and hopelessness-he bore them all!
Over and over and over again.
Now, in the section he studied that was buried beneath countless weavings, he found the collapsed existence of none other than Giuseppe.
Linked to him as a True Bearer of Despondency, Giuseppe's very foundation now resided within his Source of Existence.
Bob reached out, his limb plunging into the dazzling black wheel and wrapping around the wailing weavings that once were Giuseppe.
BZZT!
A heavy friction surged, the effort monumental, but Bob did it anyway.
He grasped the weavings, like a singularity in his hand, his eyes flickering as he began reading its memories.
A moment later, he let out a light chuckle.
"A single second...this was the extent of the forces I prepared required to be utterly erased from existence?"
He shook his head at the absurdity, but he did not deny it had happened.
Over the eons, Bob had come to understand a truth.
Existence could be utterly ridiculous. Depending on who you were and what you did, you might be embraced by the weavings of existence, or you might stand against them.
Bob was currently standing against them.
The weavings of existence, especially in an Absolute Complex True Source, were unfathomably powerful.
A single action from him could trigger a cascade of disproportionate reactions from existence itself.
Noah Osmont...he appeared to be one such disproportionate reaction.
Yet Bob continued.
For him, there was no other path, only forward.
He fed complexity into the collapsed weavings that were Giuseppe as in seconds, the wailing ceased.
Moments later, Bob released his tentacled limb, and the illusory figure of Giuseppe reformed before him.
A terrifying work of complexity.
Giuseppe regained cognizance and cried out after another few seconds.
"I WILL kill him. I will kill Osmont!"
His existence blazed with fury as the last thing he remembered was being engulfed in endless flames.
A ball of fire had consumed him and thousands of others in mere seconds.
Now, pulled from a Dead True Source, Giuseppe had become a Dead Weaving of existence that was unable to return to what he once was.
At this moment, Bob shielded his own weavings with the black and white wheels spinning above as from here on out...
HUUM!
A black suit enveloped Giuseppe's body.
His weavings of existence began to climb, rising from a Lesser Source surging toward the Prime.
Eventually, the weavings ignited with the terrifying force of an Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity. Giuseppe's screaming stopped as he fully sensed his surroundings.
Unlike his previous dreams, he saw something that was very real.
He stood before The Despondent One, fully and truly. His existence trembled.
Bob looked at him and spoke calmly:
"I told your child, even if you died... I would still call you out. Come now, step aside as the others are recalled. Your work is far from being done."
Terrifying words.
Giuseppe nodded fervently, his weavings trembling as he thought of the one who had ruined everything in the Frequency of Life.
Now, that same being had erased his weavings in the Frequency of Flames.
The feeling of his own existence collapsing and disappearing...it was one Giuseppe never wanted to experience again.
He looked at the Despondent One and wondered.
Could he ask for even more power? Enough that Osmont could never touch him again?
He asked himself this question, unaware of what was currently unfolding within an Amarantos Dream.
From the black and white wheels of existence shimmering above, surrounded by multicolored rivers of reality, Bob continued.
He pulled out collapsed weavings of existences, reviving them and making them stronger!
It was a shocking feat of complexity as from this point forward, there would be no redundancy.
His work had only begun.
After all, he wouldn't simply restore collapsed weavings to what they once were.
They had to be better.
They had to be improved!
They had to be just as ridiculous...as the one who had collapsed them!
Back in the Prime Frequency of Flames, the gazes of the Singed burned around Noah as they were intense, reverent, and expectant.
But Noah had long since grown used to such looks.
Awe, shock, and even fear- they had followed him for an extremely long period of time. They no longer stirred his existence nor strengthened his weavings. They simply were.
He called to his weavings and floated toward the towering white-gold flame, the one Emelline of the First Flame had said held the embers of Ezekiel.

He had encountered many flames in recent times. This one, in truth, seemed almost lackluster. It lacked the chilling majesty of the silver-white Primal Flame of the Wheel, or the dreadful power of the flame crafted from the fusion of his own weavings and the Infiniverse Megalos- the construct that burned at the heart of his greatest weavings.
Yet this flame before him possessed a grandeur of its own. When Noah appeared before it and placed his hand within its burning light, the Sacred Flame opened to him as if recognizing old weavings.
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3631: Past and Present! II
paragraphs: Noah closed his eyes, delving deep into the flame. With his intricate complexity and the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed, he passed through the flame with ease and began searching for the weavings of Ezekiel.

It did not take long. His will spread through the flame like Mana through rivers of reality, touching and wrapping around a particular set of weavings. And there, in the heart of what Emelline had called the Sacred Flame, part of Noah manifested as he found what he was looking for.
He saw a man, or rather, the flame-born image of one that was serene, noble, and wreathed in tranquil fire. The man met Noah's gaze and spoke, his voice echoing out with grandness!
"I did not expect my flow, once spent, to be stirred again by any complexity. To wake from the basking of countless flames, what does the Origin Singed seek of me?"
As with the others before him, Ezekiel had looked once upon Noah and decided that he was the Origin Singed.
Noah no longer questioned it as the Pathway he held must bear such purity and likeness to the True Source of the Singed that those attuned to it saw no difference.
He gave a single nod and replied evenly:
"I need to locate the pathway to the True Frequency of the Singed."
Ezekiel raised an eyebrow, amused.

"I might ask how the Origin Singed lost the path to his own home, but I know better than to question. If you wish to connect to the True Frequency, you need only connect to the weavings of every Singed in this Frequency and inscribe the Rune of the SINGED. The path will open."
So simple?
Noah nodded once more and began to withdraw from the Sacred Flame, giving a light nod of thanks to Ezekiel's weavings. As he did, the embers within the distance called out with a final flicker:
"It was good to see you again, Sir. However brief our meeting."
Noah said nothing to such words.
He emerged from the flame fully and turned towards Emelline and the other Singed who awaited him, their gazes filled with expectation.
Any other Source Complexity might have buckled under the weight of such gazes!
But Noah? He bore the crushing weight of the Infiniverse Megalos already as this was just another Monday for him.
"Come," he said, turning his gaze to each of them. "Connect your weavings to mine. The pathway to the True Frequency of the Singed must be opened."
He spoke freely.
And the Singed only glanced at each other briefly before...they obeyed without hesitation!
Mysara's eyes gleamed with anticipation, her flames burning a glorious blue.
Emelline, ever the calmest flame, smiled and nodded. She looked towards Noah, and in a voice only he could hear, she said:
"I told you before that when the weavings need the Origin Singed, he appears, whether or not he believes he is one."
Her eyes burned like miniature suns.
Noah arched a brow in response to this nonsense and then raised his hand as a tendril of flame unfurled from him, radiant and pure as it sank into Emelline's chest.
BZZT!
Light exploded. Emelline's eyes blazed white-gold, and her entire being shimmered with incandescent brilliance.
More tendrils burst from Noah, arcing out toward the assembled Singed, even those scattered across the Frequency of Flames!
Some had Sources, others only Paths or Ordinances. But they would all be connected!
Among them, Noah searched quietly as the Great Usurper's weavings were not here.

The Usurper had shown disturbing interest in the Faceless Lifeforms. His last message to Noah was a unique one as he intended to test how easily the weavings of Dead Things could be swallowed and silently usurped.
Whether he was successful, Noah didn't know.
But if the Usurper had indeed seeded his will through the Faceless Lifeforms, perhaps he could become a blade, a weapon sharp enough to pierce even Bob.
Noah mused on this only lightly. In the space of moments, a myriad of tendrils connected from him to the other Singed as his Pathway trembled, glowing with brilliance.
Now came the Rune that Ezekiel mentioned.
He summoned the flames of the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed as he began to construct the Rune of the SINGED.
The Rune was not just a word, it was intent that changed the weavings of existence in a unique fashion.

Noah's understanding of the language of runes was still forming as he knew a single word could change all things. But the Rune of the SINGED, he shaped with certainty as he poured into it all his knowledge, all his desire to find the True Frequency of the Singed.
HUUM!
The air vibrated. The weavings of existence shook.
A single word blazed to life soon after as it was magisterial to see!
SINGED!
Flames roared.
Emelline and Mysara, along with countless others released beams of brilliance from their eyes.
The entire Frequency responded. Flames stirred, converging and billowing toward the blazing Rune like moths to a sun.
It was an event that many Singed had never witnessed.
But it happened today under the banner of the True Severed Origin Osmontian!
The Rune acted as a key to a doorway that was leading toward a place impossibly close to the Wheel of Existence itself.
And Noah? He was already calculating many things with his Weavings of Existence.
He thought of Bob. He thought of the Faceless Ones who did not need to win or lose, only to come here to wage a war with the Singed.
Was it part of Bob's design, the doorway to the True Frequency of the Singed opening?
Bob, too, sought entry into the True Frequencies. Perhaps this could all be according to some ridiculous, convoluted plan of his!
So, just in case...
Even now, another body of Noah materialized in the Frequency of Flames, his hands holding the Book of Existence gifted by the Queen of Matter as he had already located the Node of this Frequency.
Whatever plans were in motion, whatever schemes unfurled by the Dead Thing that was Bob...
They would not pass through the brilliance of Noah's weavings!

chapters.title: Chapter 3632 Past and Present! III
paragraphs: Somewhere deep within the Prime Frequency of Flames, space itself decided it had had enough as it tore open under the brilliance of the rune of the SINGED!

A blinding rune, etched in raw authority of the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed and known only to the True Severed Origin Osmontian ripped open the flaming space like someone tearing a hole in reality itself.
A jagged rift, buzzing with stability and wonder, bloomed into being like a scar across the face of existence!

The Singed watched from afar, their gazes intense and reverent as their connected weavings leading into tendrils within Noah caused all of this. In the distance, tucked inside a region wrapped in so many layers of flames that most beings wouldn't dare approach, another body of Noah moved.
It phased in like an echo threading between overlapping layers of Existence as if following the Flow of Existence was optional for him.
He arrived at a certain place as without hesitation, Noah reached into the overlapping Strings of Existence in one area and pulled out...a flame.
It looked completely normal. Average, even. Like something you'd find hovering above a campfire.
But the moment his other hand, already glowing with silver-white Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence came into contact with the flame...
BZZT!
The ordinary flame pulsed, shimmered, and revealed itself as a Node of Existence.
Noah didn't flinch. He just narrowed his eyes and calmly released more Primal Flames, starting to alter the Node of this particular Prime Frequency of Flames.
He was making alterations with a single goal in mind- to make sure Bob couldn't get into this Frequency or do anything to affect it.

The changes were similar to what he'd done with the Prime Frequency of the End, but this time it was more personalized to Bob. More targeted. Every adjustment was a deliberate strike against anything tied to Bob's existential weavings!
Noah wasn't about to be a pawn in someone else's chess match, if Bob was in fact scheming something. If he had to run around struggling as he was, then Bob better be doing the same!

And honestly, with how fast Noah's power was rising- with Absolute Infinitum Existentialism, Absolute Loot Generation, True Severed Osmontian Forge, and more...he was pretty sure the only thing that could keep up with his rise in complexity was maybe the Infiniverse Megalos.
The thing was growing exponentially as it garnered more self sufficiency and was absolutely taking off currently.

Every time Noah gained something, the Infiniverse Megalos gained more. At this point, it was even moving to conduct more grandiose actions- already seeking out the Queen of Matter for yet another wondrous upgrade.

Then there was the True Adaptive Power of Existence, which had officially tagged Bob as an enemy of growth. The stronger Bob became as he recovered his power, the faster the rise of complexity for Noah!
Eventually, even Bob wouldn't be able to keep up.
So yes.
Let time pass!
Because if there was one thing Noah had learned since he started as an F-Rank Hunter, it was that given enough time, he always won.
Kings. Tyrants. Hunters. It didn't matter how long they'd reigned as if one gave him days, weeks, or sometimes just hours, they would all eventually fall.
The only question now was...how long would it take to overcome Bob?
That was all he needed to think about. His victory.
For him, there could be no other eventual outcome. There wasn't room in his mind for doubts. No what-ifs. No fears about what might happen to existence if he failed.
Because in the Weavings of the True Severed Origin Osmontian, failure was just not an option.
Others could stumble. Others could fall.
But Noah? His failure meant utter catastrophe as it could not even be feasible!
HUUM!
His eyes lit with silver-white brilliance as he finished his alterations to the Node of Existence. In the distance, he saw where another one of his bodies had opened a dazzling pathway.
It wasn't just a door as he observed its weavings and sensed their heavy complexity.
The pathway could only be crossed by entities of a certain weight- those ranked Greater Source and above!
Dozens of the Singed watched what was happening with glowing eyes as the tendrils connecting them to Noah faded.
That alone made it unique as Noah hadn't seen something like this recently.

One of his bodies stayed back, guarding the Node of Existence even after all the changes. He didn't trust anything fully. The other body drifted forward toward the convergence of flames where heat could literally melt the complexity of anyone below Greater Source.
Dozens of the Singed watched what was happening with glowing eyes as the tendrils connecting them to Noah faded.
And then, Mysara and Emelline of the First Flame stepped forward.
Each summoned secondary bodies, their figures cloaked in radiating complexity and white-gold light for Emelline, and cerulean brilliance for Mysara!
"Will Sir allow us to come as well?" Mysara asked, gripping her tight blue robe, her form pulsing with Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity.
Noah gave a quiet nod as both she and Emelline fell in behind him, flying towards the heavy convergence of flames.
WAP!
They crossed the gateway like it was nothing.
Their complexities didn't even blink at the scorching temperatures.
What came next was hard to explain.
Crossing into this new frequency wasn't like stepping from the Megalos to the Expanse, or diving into the starless dark void he entered after the True Severing.
Even using his True Source Atlas of Existence, which let him bounce across that void that seemed to connect all Frequencies of Existence felt different compared to this passage!
This was...different.
The Flames of the Singed were required just to pass through as without them? You would disintegrate, the pathway would close, and your weavings would collapse like nothing.
His True Source Atlas of Existence discovered all of this!
Noah blinked, impressed.
So there were security measures already baked in and he had gone a little overboard with his edits of the Node of Existence.
But hey, there was no harm in going a bit overboard- he had done so many times in the past!
Seconds passed, and the three of them emerged into what should be the True Frequency of the Singed.
And what they saw was...
Pure!
Unfathomably, marvelously pure weavings of existence!

He was making alterations with a single goal in mind- to make sure Bob couldn't get into this Frequency or do anything to affect it.
The changes were similar to what he'd done with the Prime Frequency of the End, but this time it was more personalized to Bob.
More targeted.
Every adjustment was a deliberate strike against anything tied to Bob's existential weavings!
Noah wasn't about to be a pawn in someone else's chess match, if Bob was in fact scheming something.
If he had to run around struggling as he was, then Bob better be doing the same!

And honestly, with how fast Noah's power was rising- with Absolute Infinitum Existentialism, Absolute Loot Generation, True Severed Osmontian Forge, and more...he was pretty sure the only thing that could keep up with his rise in complexity was maybe the Infiniverse Megalos.
The thing was growing exponentially as it garnered more self sufficiency and was absolutely taking off currently.
Every time Noah gained something, the Infiniverse Megalos gained more.
At this point, it was even moving to conduct more grandiose actions- already seeking out the Queen of Matter for yet another wondrous upgrade.
Then there was the True Adaptive Power of Existence, which had officially tagged Bob as an enemy of growth.
The stronger Bob became as he recovered his power, the faster the rise of complexity for Noah!
Eventually, even Bob wouldn't be able to keep up.
So yes.
Let time pass!
Because if there was one thing Noah had learned since he started as an F-Rank Hunter, it was that given enough time, he always won.
Kings.
Tyrants.
Hunters.
It didn't matter how long they'd reigned as if one gave him days, weeks, or sometimes just hours, they would all eventually fall.
The only question now was...how long would it take to overcome Bob?
That was all he needed to think about.
His victory.
For him, there could be no other eventual outcome.
There wasn't room in his mind for doubts.
No what-ifs.
No fears about what might happen to existence if he failed.
Because in the Weavings of the True Severed Origin Osmontian, failure was just not an option.
Others could stumble.
Others could fall.
But Noah?
His failure meant utter catastrophe as it could not even be feasible!
HUUM!
His eyes lit with silver-white brilliance as he finished his alterations to the Node of Existence.
In the distance, he saw where another one of his bodies had opened a dazzling pathway.
It wasn't just a door as he observed its weavings and sensed their heavy complexity.
The pathway could only be crossed by entities of a certain weight- those ranked Greater Source and above!
Dozens of the Singed watched what was happening with glowing eyes as the tendrils connecting them to Noah faded.
That alone made it unique as Noah hadn't seen something like this recently.
One of his bodies stayed back, guarding the Node of Existence even after all the changes.
He didn't trust anything fully.
The other body drifted forward toward the convergence of flames where heat could literally melt the complexity of anyone below Greater Source.
Dozens of the Singed watched what was happening with glowing eyes as the tendrils connecting them to Noah faded.
And then, Mysara and Emelline of the First Flame stepped forward.
Each summoned secondary bodies, their figures cloaked in radiating complexity and white-gold light for Emelline, and cerulean brilliance for Mysara!
"Will Sir allow us to come as well?" Mysara asked, gripping her tight blue robe, her form pulsing with Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity.
Noah gave a quiet nod as both she and Emelline fell in behind him, flying towards the heavy convergence of flames.
WAP!
They crossed the gateway like it was nothing.
Their complexities didn't even blink at the scorching temperatures.
What came next was hard to explain.
Crossing into this new frequency wasn't like stepping from the Megalos to the Expanse, or diving into the starless dark void he entered after the True Severing.
Even using his True Source Atlas of Existence, which let him bounce across that void that seemed to connect all Frequencies of Existence felt different compared to this passage!
This was...different.
The Flames of the Singed were required just to pass through as without them?
You would disintegrate, the pathway would close, and your weavings would collapse like nothing.
His True Source Atlas of Existence discovered all of this!
Noah blinked, impressed.
So there were security measures already baked in and he had gone a little overboard with his edits of the Node of Existence.
But hey, there was no harm in going a bit overboard- he had done so many times in the past!
Seconds passed, and the three of them emerged into what should be the True Frequency of the Singed.
And what they saw was...
Pure!
Unfathomably, marvelously pure weavings of existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3633 Past and Present! IV
paragraphs: Pure.
That was the only way to describe it.
Waves of white-gold plasma washed over the landscape. Light bent, shimmered and distorted in strange ways. It took them a moment to adjust their weavings and truly see.
And when they did, the first thing they observed was a Tree.
A towering, incandescent white tree that was so vast it dwarfed the equivalent of a thousand Omniverses in size easily!
Its trunk extended like the spine of existence itself as its branches sparkled, glowing with Wisps of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence on their ends.
Floating around it were pieces of the Wheel- massive golden constructs burning in complexity and serenity. White-gold flames curled around their rims and spokes seamlessly.

And far, far in the distance, a silver white Wheel larger than the size of the tree itself was surrounded by the Primal Flame of the Wheel, and it radiated a kind of glory that even an Undeniable Telos Prime Source would stop to stare in a daze as it was filled with majesty!
Emelline of the First Flame gasped, not because of the overwhelming grandeur before her, but because of something that was alive.
Across this impossible expanse, she could feel multiple waves of complexity.
Lifeforms pulsed in the distance, their presence unmistakable as even from this far out, the signature of Prime Source Complexity Entities radiated with terrifying clarity!
And there weren't just a few.
There were thousands!

Emelline exhaled heavily, only for something even more intense to hold her attention across the horizon. Her eyes locked on a silver-white Spoke—one of the colossal ones branching out from the distant Wheel itself. This one burned with a Primal Flame, stretching so far it looked like a smooth, infinite silver white bridge of light.
They weren't hiding either as they were scattered across the tall tree, fragments of burning Wheels, and even along the vast surface of the massive silver-white Wheel in the distance.
And the moment Noah, Emelline, and Mysara arrived, every one of those thousands of Prime Source Complexities turned their attention toward them.

It was like standing under the gaze of flaming wonders, each one buzzing with the aura of the Singed as their complexity crackled, and then... the pressure faded. In the blink of an eye, it was like all those Entities had silently recognized them, and whatever hostility there might have been simmered down right after!

Emelline exhaled heavily, only for something even more intense to hold her attention across the horizon. Her eyes locked on a silver-white Spoke—one of the colossal ones branching out from the distant Wheel itself. This one burned with a Primal Flame, stretching so far it looked like a smooth, infinite silver white bridge of light.

And on it, an entity sat. A single point, so tiny on the grand scale, but burning with an aura that crushed anything they had felt so far. This wasn't just the Prime Source level or Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity level. This was beyond that!
Dozens of other Singed surrounded the figure as if they were attending a lecture from a great being. And that figure was staring straight at them.
Even from light-years away.
Emelline trembled again as her lips moved on instinct.
"O Origin Singed..."
The Origin Singed.
THE Origin Singed?

Noah's eyes sharpened instantly, locking on the figure seated far away. His senses stretched across the weavings of existence, permeating every detail of the distant Spoke, and the figure gazed right back.
Then...that figure smiled. He raised a hand and spoke.
"Do not resist."
HUUM!
The voice echoed like a whisper made of eonic flames.
Then, with a single tap from his finger, the very space around Noah, Emelline, and Mysara began to ripple and distort as in the next moment, they vanished!
They reappeared on the silver-white Spoke, light-years from where they had stood before as the heat here was even more intense.
Dozens of Prime Source Singed sat nearby, and three of them burned with the unmistakable power of Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity.
In the center of them all sat the man cloaked in silver-white robes, his body wreathed in the Primal Flame of the Wheel as he smiled softly and spoke out.

"This is the first time a Pathway to the True Frequency of the Singed has been opened in quite some time as it startled quite a few of us. Especially now, in the middle of such...chaotic times. But still, welcome."
His voice was calm. Silver-white hair flowed down his shoulders. His face was a handsome one filled with nobility as it shone with layered complexity and grace.
But Noah wasn't focused on any of that.
Noah was locked onto one thing...the burning purity of a True Source.
A True Source!
He could feel it radiating from the man before them as a tear slid down Emelline's cheek as she stepped forward.
"O Origin Singed... you've been here this whole time?"
Her voice buzzed with emotion- awe, and confusion all jumbled into one!
The Origin Singed shook his head, a soft smile still on his lips as he replied.

"I am here... and I am not. My true Weavings remain in the Infinite Ravines, holding back the taint that tries to touch the Wheel. What you see now..." He gestured around his silver-flame-wrapped form. "Is merely a Remnant Weaving. A whisper of me. A complexity that was left behind in this True Frequency."

Noah's gaze narrowed. It was another Remnant- just like the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder he'd met recently! How many more whispers of ancient legends like the Beyonder and Origin Singed were hidden across the Frequencies while their main bodies were in the Infinite Ravines?
As Emelline processed his response, the Origin Singed turned to Mysara and gave a nod of acknowledgement, and then his eyes finally settled on Noah.

There was something almost amused behind his terrifyingly peace gaze of flames! The Origin Singed looked at another...Origin Singed. For Emelline and Mysara, it was like the past and the present were colliding as their weavings buzzed when they saw it.
"And here we have the infamous Noah Osmont...I don't know what exactly you're doing, but you've got the Flow of the Wheel buzzing constantly with every lift of your finger."
WAA!

"What I'm more curious about, is how your flames are this pure. That level of purity is something I'd expect from someone who's already attained a True Source. This is your first time entering a True Frequency of the Wheel, right? So how did you stumble onto a True Source, or even onto its path? And more importantly, what exactly brings you here?"
Question after question arose as Noah met another entity who had attained a True Source.
His eyes vibrated with the tyrannical light of Quintessence as he gazed towards the Origin Singed calmly as he replied.
"Complexity."
WAA!
"I am here for the same reason that makes countless quintillions of entities rise and struggle every waking second- more Complexity."
He was straightforward as in the surroundings, the silver white Primal Flame of the Wheel began to seethe!

chapters.title: Chapter 3634 Limitations! I
paragraphs: Complexity.
Every entity sought it, and Noah was no different.
His weavings spread out across this True Frequency of the Singed as he sought to understand everything- even as he talked to this Remnant Weaving of the Origin Singed.

The being seemed entirely carefree, carrying the air of mysteries that Noah didn't like too much- the air of those beings who acted like they had everything under control, or that because of the power they were connected to, everything would be okay.
When in fact, things were not okay.
And if the Origin Singed had a Remnant Weaving sitting in the True Frequency of the Singed, he could have moved to do something regarding Bob, right?
So he looked towards him and the silver-white wheel they sat on, as well as the many other profound structures in this space buzzing with plasma and heat, as he asked:

"I came across Remnant Weavings of the Great Beyonder not too long ago too. She at least tried to locate the Dead Thing running around the Frequencies of the Wheel when she came to. But have you been active in this True Frequency this whole time? Your True Source could potentially move freely to act if it wished?"
WAA!
His eyes flashed sharply as he made his intent clear.
Beside him, Emelline and Mysara had complex expressions, as if they had the same questions—but not the strength to actually raise them!

The Undeniable Telos Prime Source Singed and other Singed in the surroundings heard the questioning tone from Noah and became stern, one even rising up as if to ask Noah why he would question the Origin Singed like this!
But the Origin Singed smiled lightly while raising his hand, and he replied with a sense of melancholy:

"In existence, there are always limitations. I have my own constraints and limitations, as my Remnant Weavings are constrained into this True Frequency. If ever it were to be breached by those that should not be here, I am a safeguard for it. The importance of a True Frequency of the Wheel is the only reason why this Remnant Weaving is here."
The location was an important one. And so, he was there to protect it.
Noah heard such words, and they only made him dislike this ideology more and more. His gaze swept around as he replied.
"Yeah, fuck all the normal Frequencies and the Prime Frequencies and the countless lives on there, right? So long as this True Frequency is safe, they don't matter that much."
His words were sharp, and Emelline and Mysara were shocked.
The Origin Singed retained his smile as he replied right after:
"If the True Frequency is ever breached or falls, then even more countless lives and records of all Frequencies will be lost. The Wheel of Existence itself could be put at risk."
The ideology of the Origin Singed gradually became clear.
And Noah gazed back at him coldly as he replied:

"So the Flow of the Wheel moves as it does to protect itself in the long run—not those channeling through it. The Wheel flows to preserve itself and nothing else. Good to know. I'll leave that work to you all and proceed to get what I came here for."
His words caused the surrounding Singed to shudder, as if blasphemous weavings were being uttered. But the Origin Singed kept his calm as he asked quizzically:
"Do you even know what you are looking for?"
He came for complexity. But did he know how to get it in this True Frequency?
Noah simply gave a light nod to the Origin Singed as he floated up, his eyes turning toward a certain direction.
"Yeah. I've found the only thing that could possibly aid me tucked away over there."
After floating up, he shot out toward a certain direction- leaving behind the Origin Singed and all others, as the air grew heavy!

Noah's senses still covered that region as he saw Mysara's visage wrapped in blue flames rise up right behind him and follow, while Emelline of the First Flame wore a difficult expression. A second later, she gave one last gaze to the Origin Singed and then followed Noah!
It was a phenomenon that showed where their allegiances lay. As for the other Singed, this was preposterous.
And yet, the Origin Singed raised his hand again to keep the order, his gaze filled with a mixture of weavings as he seemed to be thinking of many things!
Noah pulled his gaze away from that silver spoke of the Wheel where the Origin Singed sat, continuing toward the direction that could actually aid him in increasing his complexity.

Past the shattered wheels and complete ones like the one the Origin Singed sat upon, past the tall Tree with wisps of the Flame of the Wheel on its branches, there was a place light years away that radiated waves of heavy complexity!

Around it, Existence itself distorted from its sheer brilliance. And the closer Noah got, the more he could hear and feel its booming sound, which had been silently permeating across the True Frequency of the Singed.
DUM!
Pure white.
DUM!

Unfathomably scorching—to the extent that the white brilliance overcame any gold in the surroundings. Noah neared the wonder, and his distinctions of the Weaver analyzed it as its identity became clear.
DUM!
It was... a heart.
A pure, beating heart that looked extremely detailed, with its pulmonary arteries and veins cut off. And it was cycling a shocking concentration of white flaming authority!

Around it, the white flames it cycled eventually dispersed outward to form a ring of silver-white flames. Other white flames joined the plasmic gold brilliance in the surroundings to form weavings of white-gold Wisps of the Flame of the Wheel.
It was a heart spitting out flames, and from the trunks of its aorta, there were also dazzling drops of white brilliance that occasionally flowed out and formed into a scintillating sea above.
Noah looked at such a wonder with bright eyes, as this was...
"The True Heart of Existence..."
HUUM!
In this True Frequency of the Singed, there was no Node of Existence.

He could instinctively feel the same weavings of a Node from the white heart, as this... was what served as a Node here—a Heart that was spitting out white flames that transformed into Primal Flames of the Wheel and Wisps of the Flame of the Wheel!

chapters.title: Chapter 3635 Limitations! II
paragraphs: The True Heart of Existence!
Noah felt his weavings churning and cycling at an ever faster rate the closer he neared this heart, with his Existence accelerating in its advancement of complexity!
|The Pathway to the True Source of Loot looks at the True Heart of Existence with fascination.|

|The True Heart of Existence is deemed to be the True Source of the scattered Flames of the Wheel of Existence—being merely a part of what makes up the Absolute Complex True Source that is the Wheel of Existence.|

What his weavings were discovering were an array of wonders, as the Heart before him was actually a True Source—and it was a part of what made the Wheel of Existence what it was, as from this heart came all the flames.

Noah's eyes were bright as he floated towards it, the scalding temperatures from the pumping heart being so intense that it was a question whether even Prime Source Complexity Entities could actually get near it!
But him?
BZZZT!
His golden robes billowed tyrannically as his skin only glinted with a fantastical radiance the closer he went.
His foundation and weavings of existence were already astounding enough.
His complexity held a True Source Atlas of Existence already!
His concepts were all severed 54 times over as his complexity was utterly tyrannical—where even if he didn't say it out loud, he knew that nobody else held the foundation he had at this moment!
Nobody with an astounding flow of the Wheel around them.
Not Ashmole with all his experiments. Not the Peacemaker he recently met. Not even the Great Usurper with his overbearing Soul!
"You think mere heat will keep ME away?!"
HUUM!

Flames that would later transform into Primal Flames or Wisps of the white-gold Flame of the Wheel, but at this moment...the pure white flames held a level of uniqueness that was extremely conducive to the growth of Complexity.

His expression carried the tyrannical dominance of the True Severed Origin Osmontian as he took a step forward, his existence shifting as he instantly appeared above the True Heart of Existence—specifically, above the three white tunnels of the aorta that were gushing out extremely pure white flames.

Flames that would later transform into Primal Flames or Wisps of the white-gold Flame of the Wheel, but at this moment...the pure white flames held a level of uniqueness that was extremely conducive to the growth of Complexity.
So long as one's existence could withstand them, they would be refined like molten metal and made more complex over time.
And if one was able to consume these flames without their existence burning...
Noah's eyes showed immense firmness and tyranny as he looked at the white flames flying up and flashing over his skin, his complexity booming upwards just from this proximity.
But this was nowhere near enough for him, as at this moment, his mouth began to open wide as his chest expanded—and he took a Quintessential Breath!
HUUUM!
All nearby weavings shook and tumbled as if a titan was breathing in utter majesty.

In the distance, the figures of Emelline of the First Flame and Mysara arrived as they felt the blistering heat, their weavings also advancing, but...when they neared a certain proximity to the True Heart of Existence, they actually had to come to a stop as they felt their Undeniable Telos Prime Sources actually begin to be injured from the heat and flames!
They had to stop and wait as their complexity gradually rose before they could forge ahead again.
But far in the distance, Noah stood right above the True Heart of Existence as he even breathed the unfathomably pure and scorching white flames into his body!
It felt like they were witnessing an obscene scene of tyranny, as white flames weren't the only things coming out of the trunks of the aorta.
There were scintillating drops of pure white brilliance that floated up to form a sea.
When he breathed in, the white sea above formed a spinning vortex and began to descend into his mouth and nose.
From the trunks of the aorta, drops of white dew—akin to glimmers of rain—began to float towards his mouth and nose!
All of it flowed into Noah as he drew from the purity of existence of...an already existing True Source.
His intent was singular today.
To draw from this True Heart of Existence until...a certain Pathway to the True Source of the Singed was more than halfway completed.
Until its road was completed.
Until a True Source of the Singed was obtained—bathed from the white flames and blood of the Heart of Existence itself!
HUUUM!
"Come!"
The booming roar of the True Severed Origin Osmontian echoed out of the True Frequency of the Singed, the myriad of lifeforms within unable to help but turn toward his direction.
Among the many eyes gazing over, there were also the eyes of the Origin Singed.
Within them, complex waves of thoughts swirled as he looked at Noah's figure, his thoughts indiscernible!
While a significant explosion of complexity occurred in the True Frequency of the Singed.
In the Frequency of Light.

A taint of Darkness spread across the expanse of this Frequency as massive Dark Towers were being enacted, and tens of thousands of Faceless Lifeforms at the level of Pioneers or Existence Severing entities moved, while a few dozen Lesser and Greater Sources were also present!
There was also a single Prime Source.
At this moment.
Inside the weavings of the Prime Source seated atop a Dark Tower.
"What is this..."

His voice echoed out as he peeled the white bar on the black suit he wore—and the signature burn that should have occurred...did not occur, as once the black suit that veiled everything was taken off, the black mass on the face distorted as the handsome appearance of none other than the Great Usurper took its place.
Since the Great Usurper had taken over the Source of this being, it naturally could not be rejected by the weavings of the Wheel as he made the Source his own!
And alongside this...he gained the memories of this particular Source.
Memories...that showed him an entirely different weaving of existence.
He saw countless waves of corpses that made up a vast sea of countless quintillions—and he was among these corpses.
A Prime Source with his complexity leaking of death and decimation, and as he died...his weavings managed to see a scene.
Above the seas of corpses.
In the skies.
He saw the figure of two identical entities with the same faces, but one was black, and one was white!
But both...were Bob!

chapters.title: Chapter 3636 The Dead and the Living! I
paragraphs: Above a sea of corpses.

One of the bodies among the countless quintillions held a strange complexity. Though undeniably lifeless, its eyes still shimmered with the remnants of awareness, as if recording everything unfolding around it.
It was a unique complexity of Existence!
It was into this corpse that the Great Usurper had extended his weavings into as he was observing in this moment a distant memory.
A memory that showed that, above this endless sea of death, two figures stood- arguing.
Both bore the likeness of Bob as One radiated with an obsidian luster; the other, a brilliance as pale and blinding as the color white.
Their voices echoed like thunder across the decimated sky.
"We tried it—and it did not work! It did not work, and now the collapse of an entire Wheel of Existence rests on our hands!"
HUUM!
The words were terrifying. They spoke of a terrifying failure, the breaking of something that was far too critical to life
The white-lustered Bob, whose form rippled with tentacles, had bellowed those words. The obsidian Bob regarded him with a cold, tyrannical stare.

"Do you think you're the only one who feels? Who understands? Do you think I didn't witness the shattering of the Wheel?! I know- I understand more than you think. And even though we failed here, we confirmed something critical. We can now put all our efforts into finding... THAT."
THAT.
What the fuck was THAT?
The weavings of the Great Usurper pulsed, shaken by what they were witnessing as his vision expanded across the vast sea of corpses.

Far in the distance, he saw it- the remnants of an ancient black wooden wheel. Only a fragment was visible, yet even that fragment was as vast as an entire Megalos as all these remnants stretched out across countless weavings.
Shattered.
Broken!
An entire Wheel of Existence shattered and broken. What force could have possibly caused such a cataclysm?
The white Bob stared at his obsidian counterpart, his expression hazy, grief-stricken.
He spoke again, his voice a whisper brimming with ruin and guilt.
"We were wrong. The dead and the living are far too different in the scope of existence. A dead Wheel of Existence cannot be reenergized simply by connecting to a living one."
They had tried.

They had pierced through to the True Frequencies of the Absolute Complex True Source here, examined its essence, perused its depths, inching ever closer to its core. Close enough to touch the Wheel of Existence itself as they connected a Dead True Source to a live one.
But the vibrant surge they'd expected never came.
Instead, the Dead True Source overwhelmed everything. Every spark of life was extinguished.
Countless lives across countless frequencies- gone. They were Channellers of the True Source that was the Wheel of Existence. If they simply lost that connection, it wouldn't have meant death.
But the breaking of the Wheel? That was the breaking of existence itself!
And the umbrella it cast shattered with it.
Without that shade, unless one possessed immense power or had attained their own True Source, living became nearly impossible.
The Absolute Complex True Sources provided the shade required for life. Breaking them meant breaking the very existence they upheld.
The white Bob clutched his head and collapsed to his knees, haunted by the screams of quintillions who had died by his hand.
His expression was haggard as he turned to his obsidian self, who remained composed and eerily calm.
"Is it all worth it?"
He asked the question softly.
A question he would continue to ask himself for eons to come.
Was it all worth it?
The weavings of the obsidian Bob glimmered as he looked to his other self and replied, his voice cool and resolute.
"Is it worth it to hold your child again? To see her smile? To free her from eons of torment? While her very existence is assailed again and again and again? Is. It. Worth. It?!"
HUUUM!
The sky trembled. His final words crashed like the fury of a titan across the weavings of existence!
Silence followed, heavy, as the two Bobs stood locked in solemn understanding.
It was the obsidian Bob who finally broke the quiet.

"We don't know. But connecting to another Wheel...doesn't work. And the words of that being, the one who shattered our Wheel of Existence, are only now confirmed. What we need to reenergize our own Wheel...is the very thing he was looking for within our weavings. He went about it monstrously and left only destruction in his wake. But we can do it differently. No one else has to die. We just need to find the Absolute Complex True Source, the one Wheel of Existence that can act as the key which leads to THAT."
WAA!
"If we can grasp it- if we can grasp the Construct that Innervates the Wheels of Existence themselves..."
The Construct that Innervates the Wheels of Existence.
The Usurper's weavings pulsed in awe.
It sounded far too fantastical.
The obsidian Bob turned to the white Bob, whose expression twisted with uncertainty as he responded grimly.

"There are many Wheels of Existence, many already dead, and others on the verge of collapse. And yes, a few are still alive...still vibrant. But finding the right one- the one that leads to THAT...will be a journey of endless searching. Even if we find it, every Wheel has its own protections. The living and the dead are separated by a sacred line. The living will not allow the dead to enter. They will resist. There will be deaths."

"We were once defenders of our own Wheel as we were holding back legions of dead things clawing to enter. We cannot become the very threat we once repelled, right? We cannot wage war on those who have done nothing to us...right?"
His somber expression grew a touch more resolute.
He seemed ready to ask again- was it worth it?
But instead, he turned toward his other self. He became reflective.
A decisive light then shimmered in his eyes.
"For her... and for all others whose deaths we can undo, whose lives we can restore...it will all be worth it."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3637 The Dead and the Living! II
paragraphs: For the sake of undoing all their mistakes, it would all be worth it.
For the sake of seeing her again, it would all be worth it.
The obsidian Bob and the white Bob looked at each other as an unspoken agreement bloomed between them.
Behind the obsidian Bob, a terrifying shattered, and destitute black Wheel of Existence bloomed... and began to spin.

Each rotation was slow, heavy, and agonizing as though the screams of countless lost entities echoed through its broken spokes. And this was true in a sense as with every turn of that Wheel, those contained within it felt its movements that caused them all tremendous pain! This was why they were wailing constantly....
Such a Wheel and all those within were still present.
A dead True Source of Existence, shattered by their own hands.
Unintentional, yes. But done all the same.
As the broken and dead Wheel bloomed behind the obsidian Bob, a radiant white Wheel of Existence bloomed behind the white Bob.
Waves of complexity converged between them, their bodies buzzing as if in harmony—until they were pulled toward each other.
Where once there was disagreement and division, now their Weavings of Existence aligned as one.
An obsidian Bob. A white Bob.
And in that moment, they became a single Bob.

The endless field of corpses that the Great Usurper had been observing began to stir. Slowly, impossibly, they rose- an unfathomable sea flowing toward the spinning black and white Wheels of Existence.

It looked like a procession of countless dead beings as even in their dead state, some even struggled as if they innately knew they were in for constant and endless pain for an unknown number of years to come.
But they had no power to reject anything, so they were put inside the Dead True Source.
When it came to living True Sources, rules and limitations were many, as distorting and reshaping existence was nearly impossible.
But with dead things...
With dead Wheels of Existence?
The alteration was so much easier.
From the Weavings of Existence, as the Great Usurper watched in shock, he heard Bob's voice one last time.
"For her... for all those I have imposed suffering upon..."
WAA!
For her.
It was all for her. And he had tried to make things right.
But in the end... how could the deaths of countless quintillions and the destruction of multiple Wheels of Existence ever truly be rectified?
BOOM!
The sliver of memory, seen through the eyes of a faceless lifeform, vanished—snuffed out in an instant.
The Great Usurper came to once more, his expression heavy as he softly repeated the words he'd just heard.
"The thing that Innervates Wheels of Existence..."
That was what Bob was after.
Not the Wheel itself. Not the Absolute Complex True Source that so many protected.
No. The Wheel was just a pathway... leading to something else. Something unnamed. Something more than what even someone like him knew!
The Great Usurper's expression darkened.
He needed to know more.
Only then could he continue his idle existence while the souls he had usurped moved on his behalf.
Bob had held the remnants of countless quintillion souls embedded in the Dead True Sources under his command.
No... not just Dead True Sources. That was misleading.
They had once been Absolute Complex True Sources—Wheels of Existence that had sheltered entire realities under their great shade.
And Bob now held two of them. From their husks, he brought forth Faceless Lifeforms.
Dead things to move as he pleased.
"Looks like I've got quintillions of dead souls to take over... how much complexity will that add?"
His luminous eyes flickered with uncertainty as yes, even he had doubts.
The dead and the living did not mix.
And yet here he was, seamlessly usurping the dead, making them part of him, of the Weavings of the very Wheel he now borrowed shade from.
But now...
He looked up.
He could sense the Dead Wheel of Existence, the one belonging to those he had usurped.
He could even draw power from it through them.
An array of intricate, mind-bending weavings unfolded before him as...
"I sure as hell am not taking all of this on myself."
He muttered the words to no one in particular. But thereafter, he reached out. This time, he spoke to someone.
"Hey Big Guy, you busy?"
HUUM!
He pulled the entanglement toward the one entity who made him feel like he wasn't the craziest thing in Existence —no matter how wild things became.
Existence, after all, was a progression of increasingly ridiculous things.
Things he couldn't even fathom months ago? Now done as easily as breathing.
With madness constantly unfolding, it was easy to feel like he was losing his mind... unless there was someone who operated on an even more absurd level.
The Great Usurper reached out to such a being—one whose Weavings were complex enough to drift easily through frequencies, bypassing all resistance to communicate clearly at this moment.
He asked whether he was busy.
The reply?
"Just trying to obtain a True Source. What's up?"
Just trying to obtain a True Source?
The Great Usurper paused before shaking his head.
This was the kind of crazy that reminded him he wasn't alone in it. That someone else existed out there on a level far more absurd than his own.
So, without asking how or what he meant, he continued.
"I've got some Weavings of information—just found something interesting about our dear friend, Bob. Sending it over now."
HUUM!
Power radiated from his eyes as he transmitted the scenes he had witnessed—seen through the lens of a Dead Thing.
Across frequencies, the Weavings surged.
In the True Frequency of the Singed, as Noah floated above a dazzling white heart billowing with the purest flames and blood, his eyes sharpened—radiating brilliance that could not be contained.
He received the transmission—and his Weavings buzzed with revelation.
Information about a Dead Thing.
A being far grander than anyone had anticipated.
A being who was not within these Weavings of Existence for the reasons people thought.
Bob!

He looked up.
He could sense the Dead Wheel of Existence, the one belonging to those he had usurped.
He could even draw power from it through them.
An array of intricate, mind-bending weavings unfolded before him as...
"I sure as hell am not taking all of this on myself."
He muttered the words to no one in particular.
But thereafter, he reached out.
This time, he spoke to someone.
"Hey Big Guy, you busy?"
HUUM!
He pulled the entanglement toward the one entity who made him feel like he wasn't the craziest thing in Existence —no matter how wild things became.
Existence, after all, was a progression of increasingly ridiculous things.
Things he couldn't even fathom months ago?
Now done as easily as breathing.
With madness constantly unfolding, it was easy to feel like he was losing his mind... unless there was someone who operated on an even more absurd level.
The Great Usurper reached out to such a being—one whose Weavings were complex enough to drift easily through frequencies, bypassing all resistance to communicate clearly at this moment.
He asked whether he was busy.
The reply?
"Just trying to obtain a True Source.
What's up?"
Just trying to obtain a True Source?
The Great Usurper paused before shaking his head.
This was the kind of crazy that reminded him he wasn't alone in it.
That someone else existed out there on a level far more absurd than his own.
So, without asking how or what he meant, he continued.
"I've got some Weavings of information—just found something interesting about our dear friend, Bob.
Sending it over now."
HUUM!
Power radiated from his eyes as he transmitted the scenes he had witnessed—seen through the lens of a Dead Thing.
Across frequencies, the Weavings surged.
In the True Frequency of the Singed, as Noah floated above a dazzling white heart billowing with the purest flames and blood, his eyes sharpened—radiating brilliance that could not be contained.
He received the transmission—and his Weavings buzzed with revelation.
Information about a Dead Thing.
A being far grander than anyone had anticipated.
A being who was not within these Weavings of Existence for the reasons people thought.
Bob!

chapters.title: Chapter 3638 True! I
paragraphs: The information Noah received shed light on an enemy of immense power and significance- an entity backed by not one, but two Absolute Complex Dead True Sources!
One of them had been directly affected by his actions, it's very breaking as a result of his interference.
He had already connected his own Dead True Source to another Wheel of Existence as what had occurred wasn't a re energization, but rather the shattering of another Wheel.
"And you're looking for something even more pristine than a Wheel of Existence itself..."
Noah murmured to himself calmly as billowing white flames and white blood from the True Heart of Existence continued to surge into him.

Bob was searching for something that Innervated the Wheels of Existence themselves- something so unknown and untouchable that even the unknown entity responsible for the collapse of Bob's home Wheel of Existence seemed to be seeking it as well.
"Okay."
Noah nodded, eyes gleaming with purpose and unwavering tyranny.

So much had remained unclear before. Who exactly was Bob? What were his true motives? What of the legends surrounding beings like the Beyonder and Omnifather, the Wheels of Existence, and everything else?
All of it was unknown before!
But the fog was finally lifting. For days, Noah had been in reactive mode- responding to events as they unfolded, doing what he could to stay afloat.
No more. The pieces were aligning, revealing a clearer picture of what was happening, who was involved, and why.

The legends in the Infinite Ravines- the ones who once protected the Absolute Complex True Source that was the Wheel of Existence, they had fulfilled the same role Bob once did before becoming a Dead Thing.
Now that everything had fallen into place, Noah's path was equally clear.

"Attain the True Sources of all my Severed Weavings. Prevent Bob from acquiring access to whatever Innervates the Wheels of Existence so that he doesn't kill off every single thing accidentally. Step into the Infinite Ravines where the Beyonder and the Omnifather are. Observe the growth of the Infiniverse Megalos...and find time to retire on my farm."
Just a few tasks. Easy enough, right?
Noah chuckled, his smile sharp with Quintessence and Tyranny! Despite everything, his goals had never wavered.
When Existence collapses around you, don't be the weakest thing left behind- the one who couldn't do anything as the walls fell.

Right now, those collapsing walls were being brought down by Bob and the countless Dead Things in the Infinite Ravines. What he had to become was not a weak piece of the puzzle, but one of its greatest Bosses.
And the first step toward that? The attainment of the True Source beside his True Source Atlas of Existence.
He looked down at the pulsing, white heart, while another body of his within the Frequency of the End gazed upon the visage of Ashmole.
The two of them stood in a cornfield Noah had woven from Dreams, stretching a full light-year wide. He had brought Ashmole here, to this place of peace.
The tentacle from the Pathway to the True Source of the Eldritch Expanse faded from Ashmole's forehead, his eyes dimming, losing their glimmering haze of white and black radiance.
His weavings returned into his body. He gazed at the endless rows of corn, then at Noah who stood silently beside him before speaking.
"You truly did live. In all of the lives I saw for you, the memory that made you happiest was standing before fields of corn in every single Frequency."
"So I brought you here to give you your send-off."
WAA!
Ashmole remained silent.
He placed a hand to his chest, searching within himself. Then he looked outward, toward the light-year-long stretch of golden corn.
His eyes shimmered with regret and infinite possibilities as he finally spoke, voice gentle.
"Existence is not fair."
"Some are born on a much higher level than others. No matter how hard one tries, they'll never reach the same height as someone who was simply born with more."

"Existence is not fair...but it's also unfathomable, vast, and filled with endless potential and possibilities. I've seen it across the myriad Frequencies I've touched. In this one, this Wheel of Existence with its terrifying flow- you, Noah Osmont, are beyond measure. But I know that out there, in other weavings and wheels of existence...there are others. I'm certain someone even more ridiculous than you exists. I hope the day comes when you meet them. An entity that makes you feel like an ant before an elephant. One who brushes aside your complexity like it's nothing but cotton. And when that day comes, Osmont...remember me."
WAA!
Ashmole's voice fell quiet.
Noah met his gaze and nodded, offering no arguments and no words. This being, this Alchemist of Existence, deserved his peace. At that moment, Noah simply tapped out.
Raw Power leaked from his form.
He borrowed the weight and grandeur of the growing Infiniverse Megalos as the brilliance surged through his body, coalescing around Ashmole and then...it began to disintegrate him.
His True Source Atlas of Existence spun with a thunderous boom as it began erasing all traces of Ashmole as the being broke down into glowing motes of ash!
Noah watched with calm reverence as prompts began to bloom before his eyes.
|An Undeniable Telos Prime Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Existence has been obtained from the collapsed Weavings of the Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity, Ashmole.|
The loot box manifested, and Noah opened it right after.
A swirl of multicolored brilliance erupted in the heart of the cornfield and turned into wonders.
|x29 Undeniable Telos Purified Source Pearls have been obtained from the Undeniable Telos Prime Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Ashmole.|
|The Records of the Origin of Existence have been obtained from the Undeniable Telos Prime Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Ashmole.|
|The Records of the Weavings of Ashmole have been obtained from the Undeniable Telos Prime Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Ashmole.|
Loot!

Waves of power and knowledge flowed in. With the opened loot boxes of Giuseppe, the three other Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity Faceless Lifeforms, Ashmole, and the thousands of Lesser and Greater sources he had decimated, along with the scorching purity of blood and flame from the True Heart of Existence....something monumental was within his reach.
He placed a hand to his chest and closed his eyes. There, he saw the flickering flame of the Singed within.
And he called out.
"Be true, O Singed."
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3639 True! II
paragraphs: Be true.
He spoke grandly like a teacher addressing a student. Like a blacksmith commanding their hammer. Like his very existence was summoning the weavings of the Singed to take their next step forward!
And in the true Frequency of the Singed, a profound change began to bloom as countless eyes turned toward it.
The Remnant Weavings of the Origin Singed looked on, seated atop a silver-white spoke over the Wheel.
The figures of Emelline of the First Flame and Mysara floated in the distance, near the True Heart of Existence. Their Sources thrummed and resonated as they turned their gazes toward Noah.
Everyone could feel it- something was about to happen, even if they didn't know what.
And the man atop the trunks of the Aorta of the True Heart of Existence stopped breathing in those terrifying, pure white flames and blood. His body radiated a pulse of unfathomable light.
He floated, wrapped in grandeur as white flames and shimmering seas of purity spun around him, encircling freely.
A moment of peace. Of raw and Quintessential power.
And then...
DUM!
Like the beating of a celestial heart, Noah raised his leg and took a step forward.
As though he were walking a path- a sacred road he had built himself!
He had walked this pathway for so long. He had constructed it with his own hands, with countless authorities and treasures from boundless Sources.
And now, this final step...this was the step Existence would witness.
They saw only that step. None of the storms it took to reach this point. None of the trials and tribulations!
Only the movement.
And with that single step, from one end of the path to the other...
BOOM!
His body was consumed in a dazzling bloom of white-gold flame thay covered everything.
The flames swallowed even the True Heart of Existence! They engulfed Emelline and Mysara!
They stretched outward for a full light-year, a storm of power impossibly vast and endlessly complex!
Emelline and Mysara felt their own weavings buzz violently as they were subjugated by waves of purification, their complexities beginning to surge uncontrollably.
The flame that bloomed from Noah was so intricate, so pure, that even the distant form of the Origin Singed stood, no longer seated.
He stared ahead, eyes gleaming, as he and countless others bore witness to the emergence...of a True Source.
A True Source of the Singed, born in a fashion never seen before.
HUUM!
| The Pathway to the True Source of the Singed has been walked. |
| At the end of the pathway, you have obtained the True Source of the Singed. |
| The complexity of your existence has undergone a significant advancement as a new milestone has been achieved. |
Complexity!
A strange, curious thing to try and measure.
The complexity of a Source was unlike anything else as it varied depending on the one who walked the path.
Countless beings had come before Noah as many had walked their own roads and become Lesser, Greater, or Prime Sources.
And yet Noah's path was something else entirely. His Source was different! So vastly different from all who came before him.

Within a certain Mundi of Power in the True Source Atlas of Existence, a flame bloomed that was so blindingly bright that the moment it was born, it spread across the entire wheel-like structure of the Atlas.
It touched the other Mundis of Power. It permeated all of Noah's existence.
And then...
| Quintessence welcomes the emergence of the first True Source. |
| Infinity welcomes the emergence of the first True Source. |
| Cheats welcomes... |
The True Flames of the Singed surged and everything welcomed their emergence.
And as the flames spread
| The True Source of the Singed declares that no Severed Weavings shall remain in the body of the True Severed Origin Osmontian unless they have begun their Pathway to the True Source. |
Noah possessed many concepts that had been severed by the Singed.
They had contributed 54 Severings to each weaving once they reached their halfway point. Now, with this pathway completed and a True Source attained, the Singed would continue its Severings.
In one sweeping motion...it would push them all 27 more times until every single one reached the Final Severed State!
Until they achieved 81 Severings and opened their own Pathways.
His Source of Ingeniare.
His Weavings of Paradox, Uncertainty, Farming, and so many more.
All would enter the Final Severed State.
All would begin their journeys toward becoming Pathways.
The bloodlines, distinctions, and weavings under the True Severed Origin Osmontian would form their own Pathway to a True Source.
The identities of Weaver of Existence and Extremity, they too would attain their Final Severed States.
Even the concepts themselves- of Extremity and Existence, were drawn in.
HUUM!
| The Severed Weavings of Existence itself begin to edge toward the Final Severed State and attain their Pathway to the True Source of Existence through the flames of the Singed. |
Existence.
A terrifying concept.
Difficult to raise, even with the rarest of resources or loot.
It was never selected by the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity.
Never caught in the calculations of the Golden Ratio.
It had only ever been slowly elevated bit by bit by the Singed.
And now, brought to its fifty-fourth Severing by that same flame, it surged toward its final Severing.
What it's Pathway would bring, what the True Source of Existence would become...Noah could only imagine.
But in that moment as his existence evolved to a shocking new stage of complexity, as the True Source of the Singed emerged...
Every part of him was pulled forward.
Willing or not.
His rising existence exploded with acceleration, and the many, many aspects that composed him surged as each went towards becoming a Pathway!
The weight of it all was tyrannical.
BOOM!
The massive flame cloaking him seethed, roared, trembled.
And in the distance, even the standing Origin Singed bore a look of wariness at the impossible purity now whirling around Noah like a storm forged by the purest of Existence itself!

chapters.title: Chapter 3640 True! III
paragraphs: The Origin Singed welcomed the sight of a new, profound purity.
Over the years, it had witnessed a few entities who surpassed the Weavings of Existence and were capable enough to attain a True Source.
It had even stood beside many entities who held True Sources and were now fighting alongside it in the Infinite Ravines.
Even if their complexity was higher, the level of purity this new entity exhibited... seemed unmatched. Even compared to itself!
How could a being in the distance obtain such purity?

That question buzzed through the mind of the Origin Singed as, at that moment, it turned to look behind towards an extremely distant location- one that very few, if any, even knew existed within the True Frequency of the Singed.
A place closest to the Wheel of Existence. Where, if one possessed enough purity, they might just catch a glimpse of it.
But that was bad.
Very bad.
Nobody should be able to glimpse the Wheel of Existence.
It was too pristine- its weavings too intricate to be observed or touched by any Existence.
Even the Singed dared not entrench upon its weavings. It left them untouched.
But what choice would this new entity make?
Choices.
They remained the one constant every existence had to make.
And depending on the choices made, existence could flow in a completely different direction!
BOOM!
The birth of a True Source was a unique phenomenon- so much so that even Noah paused, taking a few seconds to marvel at it.

When he had obtained the True Source Atlas of Existence, the sensation had already been profound. The choice to shape his own flow of existence, whether to align with the existing flow of the Wheel or to create his own divergent path, was unfathomable.
But this new source... it was even clearer. More defined.
He felt like an object floating in a vast sea- a sea filled with waves, twists, and turns. Most simply flowed with the tide, swept away by its overwhelming force.

Entities like him, the Great Usurper, the Queen of Matter, the Beyonder, the Peacemaker, and others- they all carried their own waves in this sea. Their mere movement could shift its flow in their vicinity.
But in the end, they were still within the sea.
Now, Noah had gained the ability to step out of it like a few others.
Others who were weaker may not be able to survive the separation, but he could.

The flames of the Singed burned with terrifying allure, elevated by this new True Source. It held far more flexibility than the Atlas of Existence, and his complexity had multiplied dramatically in a short period of time.
He could now feel it as he felt the endless flows of Existence that passed through frequencies all around him.
A convergence point where countless flows of the sea gathered.
Because even though the sea seemed endless, it didn't spread infinitely in all directions. All its countless weavings... were converging toward a single point.
If anyone wanted access to the vast sea, they had to pass through that one entry and exit.
And at this moment, Noah could sense that access point.
It was distant.
It was extremely far away!
But he knew what it was.
The Infinite Ravines.
His weavings shimmered with curiosity, his complexity rising as he began preparing for his next move.
His body's weavings in the Amarantos Dream churned.
He sat atop an obsidian-gold mountain, his upper body bare. Beside him lay Azzurra, the Lost Avatar of the Beyonder, breathing peacefully with closed eyes as her gorgeous figure was barely covered.
She looked... unburdened. The countless shackles that had weighed her down were vanishing.
Then, she heard Noah's voice beside her.
"I have located the True Frequency of the Singed and obtained my True Source."
He said it as casually as commenting on the weather.
Nonchalantly as if it was nothing much!
And yet—
BOOM!
Waves of immense complexity burst from Azzurra's body as the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder returned in full. It was almost like it had always been there and had not fully left.
"What the fuck do you mean you've obtained a True Source? It's been less than an hour since I last talked to you—!"
She had started with confusion but was abruptly silenced.
Because Noah's body erupted in a silent, blazing radiance- a white-gold flame that radiated nothing but the raw allure of a True Source.
Azzurra stared, stunned. Her dazed eyes looked as though they questioned the very foundation of reality.
She had no words.
Noah simply smiled, looking toward her as he spoke.
"I believe I can sense the Infinite Ravines where all those legends I've heard about are said to reside. I'll send one of my bodies over."
He was ready to begin.
But before he could move, the Great Beyonder's expression shifted sharply as she shook her head and shouted,
"No!"
"No?" Noah raised an eyebrow at her outburst.
She continued, her voice stern...as if she was about to unveil a secret she did not mention before.

"Something all of us eventually realized in the Infinite Ravines...is that it's a place of Absolute Complex True Weavings. It...traps whatever True Source enters. Any entity with a True Source that has been channeled by the Wheel of Existence will have their entire Source locked down inside that place! That's why none of us have returned."
HUUM!
