One can step out and experience the convergence point of all Existence's weavings. The Infinite Ravines can even elevate one's complexity further due to their brilliance. But so long as the Wheel still senses the approach of the dead things, it will remain closed to ensure nothing passes through. All of us...we've been inadvertently made into guards. Protectors of a home we can never return to unless we leave behind little threads of ourselves. Remnant Weavings. Trace Wills. Echoes that barely contain our true power."

"If we push too much True Source into them...we risk creating entanglements that link back to the Wheel, violating its will. One of us, driven mad after countless eons, tried returning. They sent over more than half their True Source forcefully...and during the chaos that followed because of his actions, an injured Dead Thing was able to pierce the Ravines and enter the weavings of the Wheel."

sentences.text: The Origin Singed welcomed the sight of a new, profound purity.
Over the years, it had witnessed a few entities who surpassed the Weavings of Existence and were capable enough to attain a True Source.
It had even stood beside many entities who held True Sources and were now fighting alongside it in the Infinite Ravines.
Even if their complexity was higher, the level of purity this new entity exhibited... seemed unmatched.
Even compared to itself!
How could a being in the distance obtain such purity?

That question buzzed through the mind of the Origin Singed as, at that moment, it turned to look behind towards an extremely distant location- one that very few, if any, even knew existed within the True Frequency of the Singed.
A place closest to the Wheel of Existence.
Where, if one possessed enough purity, they might just catch a glimpse of it.
But that was bad.
Very bad.
Nobody should be able to glimpse the Wheel of Existence.
It was too pristine- its weavings too intricate to be observed or touched by any Existence.
Even the Singed dared not entrench upon its weavings.
It left them untouched.
But what choice would this new entity make?
Choices.
They remained the one constant every existence had to make.
And depending on the choices made, existence could flow in a completely different direction!
BOOM!
The birth of a True Source was a unique phenomenon- so much so that even Noah paused, taking a few seconds to marvel at it.
When he had obtained the True Source Atlas of Existence, the sensation had already been profound.
The choice to shape his own flow of existence, whether to align with the existing flow of the Wheel or to create his own divergent path, was unfathomable.
But this new source... it was even clearer.
More defined.
He felt like an object floating in a vast sea- a sea filled with waves, twists, and turns.
Most simply flowed with the tide, swept away by its overwhelming force.
Entities like him, the Great Usurper, the Queen of Matter, the Beyonder, the Peacemaker, and others- they all carried their own waves in this sea.
Their mere movement could shift its flow in their vicinity.
But in the end, they were still within the sea.
Now, Noah had gained the ability to step out of it like a few others.
Others who were weaker may not be able to survive the separation, but he could.
The flames of the Singed burned with terrifying allure, elevated by this new True Source.
It held far more flexibility than the Atlas of Existence, and his complexity had multiplied dramatically in a short period of time.
He could now feel it as he felt the endless flows of Existence that passed through frequencies all around him.
A convergence point where countless flows of the sea gathered.
Because even though the sea seemed endless, it didn't spread infinitely in all directions.
All its countless weavings... were converging toward a single point.
If anyone wanted access to the vast sea, they had to pass through that one entry and exit.
And at this moment, Noah could sense that access point.
It was distant.
It was extremely far away!
But he knew what it was.
The Infinite Ravines.
His weavings shimmered with curiosity, his complexity rising as he began preparing for his next move.
His body's weavings in the Amarantos Dream churned.
He sat atop an obsidian-gold mountain, his upper body bare.
Beside him lay Azzurra, the Lost Avatar of the Beyonder, breathing peacefully with closed eyes as her gorgeous figure was barely covered.
She looked... unburdened.
The countless shackles that had weighed her down were vanishing.
Then, she heard Noah's voice beside her.
"I have located the True Frequency of the Singed and obtained my True Source."
He said it as casually as commenting on the weather.
Nonchalantly as if it was nothing much!
And yet—
BOOM!
Waves of immense complexity burst from Azzurra's body as the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder returned in full.
It was almost like it had always been there and had not fully left.
"What the fuck do you mean you've obtained a True Source?
It's been less than an hour since I last talked to you—!"
She had started with confusion but was abruptly silenced.
Because Noah's body erupted in a silent, blazing radiance- a white-gold flame that radiated nothing but the raw allure of a True Source.
Azzurra stared, stunned.
Her dazed eyes looked as though they questioned the very foundation of reality.
She had no words.
Noah simply smiled, looking toward her as he spoke.
"I believe I can sense the Infinite Ravines where all those legends I've heard about are said to reside.
I'll send one of my bodies over."
He was ready to begin.
But before he could move, the Great Beyonder's expression shifted sharply as she shook her head and shouted,
"No!"
"No?" Noah raised an eyebrow at her outburst.
She continued, her voice stern...as if she was about to unveil a secret she did not mention before.
"Something all of us eventually realized in the Infinite Ravines...is that it's a place of Absolute Complex True Weavings.
It...traps whatever True Source enters.
Any entity with a True Source that has been channeled by the Wheel of Existence will have their entire Source locked down inside that place!
That's why none of us have returned."
HUUM!
"When the Wheel senses a constant threat bearing down on it, it shuts everything out.
For the last few eons, the Infinite Ravines have been sealed.
One can step out and experience the convergence point of all Existence's weavings.
The Infinite Ravines can even elevate one's complexity further due to their brilliance.
But so long as the Wheel still senses the approach of the dead things, it will remain closed to ensure nothing passes through.
All of us...we've been inadvertently made into guards.
Protectors of a home we can never return to unless we leave behind little threads of ourselves.
Remnant Weavings.
Trace Wills.
Echoes that barely contain our true power."
"If we push too much True Source into them...we risk creating entanglements that link back to the Wheel, violating its will.
One of us, driven mad after countless eons, tried returning.

They sent over more than half their True Source forcefully...and during the chaos that followed because of his actions, an injured Dead Thing was able to pierce the Ravines and enter the weavings of the Wheel."

chapters.title: Chapter 3641 True! IV
paragraphs: The words of the Great Beyonder were heavy, filled with the weight of shocking truths as Noah looked at her sternly.
The convergence point of the Absolute Complex True Source, the Wheel of Existence, was more like a prison. Nothing could enter or leave.

The native inhabitants of the Wheel of Existence had some leeway. They could send their Remnant Weavings or Trace Wills down. But ever since the Wheel shifted into a defensive state- bombarded from all sides of the Infinite Ravines by countless Dead Things, it had closed itself off entirely.
Any True Source that entered it was forced to remain there.
And if someone tried to force their way in like petulant children throwing a tantrum outside a locked house...
Well, a lot could go wrong!

One such legend had done exactly that. Tired of endless battles and the responsibility of protecting the Infinite Ravines, they tried to return- sending at least half of their weavings back into the Wheel of Existence.
The result? A Dead Thing slipped through.
Bob!
Noah's gaze sharpened as he stared at the Great Beyonder, who went on:

"He tried to fix his mistake. Sacrificed that half of his True Source to destroy the thing he let in. We thought he succeeded, we thought only a tiny fragment of that Dead Thing remained, so small it would collapse on its own. We didn't expect it to survive, thrive...and rise stronger than ever within the Wheel of Existence where the rest of us can't even return."
Noah remained silent, his weavings making rapid calculations, while the Great Beyonder continued.

"We confirmed it's the True Source of an existence that gets locked within the Infinite Ravines. When we once brought a Prime Source Complexity Entity there, they could still go in and out, because the issue was only with True Sources. I believed the Wheel found True Sources difficult to manage inside itself and that's why it kept them out. But beings at the Prime Complexity level? That wasn't too difficult."

"But all the Dead Things? They possess True Sources. They're dead, yes, but they can survive outside the umbrella of a Wheel of Existence, at least for a while...because of their powerful True Sources. In the Infinite Ravines, anything less than a True Source will be crushed. Ground down by the purity and convergence of existence. They wouldn't survive even a minute"
Her gaze was heavy as she raised her eyes to him, almost pleading!

"So no. Don't come. You're the first entity in ages to rise with a True Source...and also have someone like me to explain what's happening. Everyone else who attains a True Source? They all feel the same pull. That same brilliance of the convergence- the old weavings of the Wheel calling out towards the Infinite Ravines. And maybe...maybe that's the Wheel's intentional doing. Creating more guards for itself. Or maybe it's just how existence is woven as there is nothing inherently malicious with it. Maybe the constant attacks from Dead Things forced the Wheel into a defensive state...and that changed everything."

"I don't know the full truth. I can't say the full truth. But if you step into the Infinite Ravines, the True Source you just forged- most, if not all of its power- will be pulled there. You'll find very little of your complexity remains behind."
WAA!
Her eyes held complex emotions. Through her words, one could sense doubt- not toward Noah, but toward the intentions of the Wheel itself.
The Wheel of Existence was not fair.
The Wheel of Existence was not kind.
It reacted instinctively to threats, and its changes were absolute.
As Noah finished listening, his gaze hardened with calmness. He asked the Great Beyonder.

"If a True Source gets locked down in the Infinite Ravines, shouldn't it be fine...if the existence holds multiple True Sources? If only one Source is trapped, another Source can remain active within the Wheel."
He spoke such wild, nonsensical words that the Great Beyonder couldn't help but blink, then burst into laughter.

"Multiple True Sources in one existence? That's a dream, big guy. The Wheel of Existence itself is a single True Source. Any entity that raises their complexity high enough can only attain one. You're telling me that you, who just barely awakened your first True Source...already believe you can forge a second? A third? A True Source is the very definition of your existence. One cannot have multiple definitions."
She shook her head, a wry smile tugging at her lips. She had head some insane things lately, but this? This topped them all.
"No. If you've awakened your True Source here, then use it. Cleanse the Wheel of Existence from the inside. Stop that Dead Thing from continuing to run rampant."
Noah looked at her valiant expression as he shook his head. She didn't believe him, and honestly...he didn't need her to.
He already had two True Sources.
The True Source Atlas of Existence, and now, the True Source of the Singed.

He simply gave her a calm look, saying nothing about the body of his that was already burning with the brilliance of the True Flame of the Singed as it departed the Infiniverse Megalos and entered that unfathomably dark expanse he only felt when he Severed his Weavings of Existence.

He didn't tell her how that part of him followed the flow of an endlessly vast sea headed toward the point of convergence. Whether the journey took hours or days...he did not know. But at least he had already begun.
What he did say was far more simple as he nodded.
"With the attainment of a True Source, I can now more easily peer across the frequencies of existence. I'll find the Dead Thing and have a rematch."
His eyes glowed with luminous brilliance as he thought of Bob and his own complex weavings of existence now.
This time, after such a tremendous jump in complexity, how would he fare against a being that held two Absolute Complex True Source that were dead and shattered black and white Wheels?
The answer would only be found by trying.
And to locate Bob...
He turned his attention to his main body, still within the Infiniverse Megalos.
He was currently looking at the Queen of Matter, the Infiniverse Megalos Body positioned beside her, watching her as the weavings of the three states of existence swirling around her.
Matter. Dark Matter. Anti-Matter.

The Infiniverse Megalos sought to tap into the Fabled Weavings of Existence granted by the Queen of Matter. She sought to use her gaze to pierce the frequencies of existence and locate a single, slippery Dead Thing.

Add to that the fact that Noah's rise with the Singed's True Source had begun to ignite a True Flame within the very depths of the Infiniverse Megalos itself as its foundation built from Noah's weavings...its complexity was rising sharply.
And because of that, finding the hidden figure of Bob...was now only a matter of time!

chapters.title: Chapter 3642 Existence! I
paragraphs: Above the massive multicolored Infiniverse Vein of Existence that pulsed with intense waves of complexity that would put even Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity entities to shame.

The figures of the Infiniverse Megalos and the Queen of Matter stood at a small point of this Vein that was countless light-years long, with one of Noah's bodies standing near them as they sought to spread a search across frequencies to lock down a single enemy!

With Noah attaining a True Source while all other entities with such a level of power were supposedly pulled into the Infinite Ravines, he was the only one who could potentially face the terror that was Bob!
So he observed the nervousness on the Queen of Matter as the right hand of the Infiniverse Megalos was shimmering with light while it pierced into her chest.
As if it was playing and molding her Source of Existence itself, tweaking it in a way that only it understood!
But while this process was taking place...Noah's complexity was still continuing to surge.
And at this moment, one particular part of himself underwent its 81st Severing.
|The Pathway to the True Source of Existence has opened.|
HUUM!
A grandiose Pathway unfolded.
The Infiniverse Megalos and the Queen of Matter were forced to turn and gaze at Noah as around him, a stellar black radiance with hues of purple erupted and surged high.
And yet...it seemed like the start of something even more magisterial than that as within Noah's weavings, his True Source Atlas of Existence turned while the True Source of the Singed flickered.
Thereafter, all of Noah pulsed and radiated a glorious obsidian purple brilliance as his Complexity proceeded to have another massive jump, with prompts appearing right after to explain why!
|Your Existence has already attained the True Source Atlas of Existence.|
|Your Existence has already attained the True Source of the Singed.|
|Multiple parts of your Existence have already attained True Source as, by Definition, your Existence is and holds a True Source.|
BZZT!
|The Pathway to the True Source of Existence is traversed in an instant as, by its truest Definition, your Existence has long since become a True Source.|
Noah's weavings radiated an intense luminosity.
His mind buzzed crazily as deep within him, there was a surge of unfathomable radiance as a third True Source bloomed!
The quickest that any True Source had bloomed in Existence, and it turned out to be for the weavings of Existence themselves.
Obsidian radiance that shone with stellar hues of wonder that made him seem entirely otherworldly flowed out.
The Queen of Matter looked in his direction and couldn't help but shake her head in wonder.
"You are the coolest fucking existence I've ever come across..."
She uttered those words even as the hand of a terrifying construct pulsed within her chest.
Noah's eyes radiated a stellar black brilliance as he felt the weavings of his third True Source being born. With its advent came a storm of new possibilities.
He felt the budding True Source of Existence communicating with him—its weavings speaking, teaching, and explaining what it truly meant to possess such a thing.

The first and foremost lesson: from this point forward, now that he had obtained the True Source of Existence, every single one of his weavings- those already on their own path toward becoming True Sources, would experience a terrifying acceleration.
Because he now held the True Source of Existence, the rest of his weavings were being pulled upward, as though they only needed to follow the thread.
Their destinations, their individual True Sources were now almost inevitable. All they needed was for him to attain a sufficient level of complexity in each to reach them!
The True Source of Existence would now permeate every one of them, ensuring that their progression would move ten times faster than before.
That was lesson one.
Lesson two dealt with existence itself.

As his body became layered in stellar obsidian radiance, his vision shifted. He looked at the Queen of Matter and the Infiniverse Megalos Body with new clarity. Slowly, he floated toward them and spoke.

"Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter... at the end of the day, they're just different states of existence. They hold distinct differences and can never truly fuse with each other. But...if the True Source of Existence wraps around them?"
He smiled.
"They can only listen and follow."
HUUM!
As he spoke, he placed his hands on the shoulders of the Infiniverse Megalos Body. Her figure lit up, covered in the stellar obsidian radiance of the True Source of Existence.

The weavings were pumped into her, overflowing from her eyes as they shone with this terrifying light. At the same time, the hand that was sunk into the Queen of Matter's chest tightened its grip on her Source, and the authority of the True Source of Existence began to flow into her- into her Source of Fabled Matter.
"Holy shiiiit!"
The Queen of Matter screamed with equal parts shock and exhilaration as her Source, once purely Fabled Matter, began to expand.
She could feel it being torn apart and rebuilt at its very foundations.
From the surroundings, different flows of Dark Matter and Anti-Matter surged toward her Source, drawn in with force and purpose.
By every law of Existence, she should have exploded right there on the spot. The clash of such unstable states of existence should've ripped her apart with unimaginable instability.
And yet...
The stellar obsidian brilliance of the True Source of Existence stabilized the fusion. It prevented any disharmony between the three elemental states.
Then, the voice of the Infiniverse Megalos Body rang out.

"The Source of the Queen of Matter has successfully been integrated with Dark Matter and Anti-Matter as well. Temporarily, the Fabled Tri-Matter Source of Existence has been born. I will now proceed to connect to their weavings and use the complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos itself to begin scanning frequencies blanketed in these same states of existence."
Her words were heavy and powerful as in that moment, the Infiniverse Vein of Existence beneath them began to glow and vibrate, radiating terrifying brilliance in every direction.
From Noah, the stellar black radiance of the True Source of Existence spread outward, casting a dee hue across the surroundings- like paint across the fabric of Existence itself!
In front of him, the Queen of Matter raised her head.
Her eyes gleamed as obsidian beams of stellar light burst from within, and she laughed wildly and shouted:
"I can feel so much! Haha, so, so much! So many Fables! So many stories!"
Her laughter was one of crazed wonder.
Like someone who had been reading only one book her entire life...
And had just discovered there were two more she'd been missing all along!

"The Source of the Queen of Matter has successfully been integrated with Dark Matter and Anti-Matter as well.
Temporarily, the Fabled Tri-Matter Source of Existence has been born.
I will now proceed to connect to their weavings and use the complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos itself to begin scanning frequencies blanketed in these same states of existence."
Her words were heavy and powerful as in that moment, the Infiniverse Vein of Existence beneath them began to glow and vibrate, radiating terrifying brilliance in every direction.
From Noah, the stellar black radiance of the True Source of Existence spread outward, casting a dee hue across the surroundings- like paint across the fabric of Existence itself!
In front of him, the Queen of Matter raised her head.
Her eyes gleamed as obsidian beams of stellar light burst from within, and she laughed wildly and shouted:
"I can feel so much!
Haha, so, so much!
So many Fables!
So many stories!"
Her laughter was one of crazed wonder.
Like someone who had been reading only one book her entire life...
And had just discovered there were two more she'd been missing all along!

chapters.title: Chapter 3643 Existence! II
paragraphs: Now, this moment could arguably be considered the happiest moment in the life of the Queen of Matter.

She had the man she idolized standing before her. Beside him towered the manifestation of a terrifying construct- something he had raised from a spiritual floating island. It was now somehow even larger than any Megalos she had seen as honestly, it could already be considered a full-on Frequency!

She had all of them before her, and the Construct's manifestation had its very hand dug deep into their Source, which was currently expanded and reformed- transformed into something capable of handling multiple states of existence at once!
She could feel the Fables within each of them.
Her entire body was surrounded by swirling books that trembled with power, glowing with incandescent light as they recorded the Fables of all states of matter across all Frequencies.
But what this construct, what the Infiniverse Megalos Body was doing wasn't just viewing Fables across states and Frequencies.
It was searching for a single person's Fable across every Frequency and every possible state of existence that person had appeared in.
And it was doing this using someone else's Source.
After expanding it in an unfathomable way, its current usage being something the Queen of Matter herself could never even attempt, the Infiniverse Megalos Body was doing the impossible!
'Ah...am I actually playing a critical role in the Fable of the True Emperor of Quintessence? I didn't get absorbed into the Harem? I didn't get forgotten?!'
Those were the thoughts dancing through the Queen of Matter's mind even as her own weavings expanded and spread across Frequencies to search.
The hunt for Bob had begun.

Opposite her, Noah's figure radiated a stellar obsidian brilliance as he turned in a certain direction and voiced an intent that was inaudible to most, but one that rippled through entanglement to reach a distant entity.
To the Great Usurper.
"If you've started commandeering the souls of dead things within the Wheels of Existence surrounding Bob, can you pinpoint the location of those Wheels, or where he himself might be?"
He sent the question, and it didn't take long for a reply to come.

"Maybe. Possibly. But the moment I do that, he'll sense me and start purging my access. I've already usurped a few million weak ones as I climb toward the stronger ones. I could use them to get a general direction. But if you're already searching... are you confident you can secure a unilateral, absolute victory in just a few moves?"
The Great Usurper knew Noah well.
They both preferred fights that ended quickly- it meant the gap in power was wide enough!
But Noah couldn't answer with confidence just yet as he looked at his Weavings. He simply replied,

"This enemy this time is different. Compared to the others I've faced, I can't say for sure. But the last time I fought him, I didn't have a True Source. Now I do. So, we will see. Let me know if you can find a general direction. I've already cast a wide net across Frequencies as it might take a while."
On the other end, the Great Usurper took a moment before responding, as if weighing his words.

"I've begun searching for a more specific trail. The weavings of the Dead Wheels of Existence are murky, but...they have passed through the Frequency of Aqua, the Frequency of Gold, and the Frequency of Normada..."
WAA!
As Noah received his words, he turned toward the Infiniverse Megalos Body and spoke aloud.
"Focus the search on the Frequencies of Gold, Normada, and Time..."
He didn't give exact coordinates- just places Bob may have passed through or could still be hiding in.
A massive search unfolded, all in pursuit of a grandiose Fable tied to a dead entity with multiple True Sources.
It was going to be a wondrous search as at such a time...
HUUM!
Noah's weavings vibrated with terrifying power. He turned his head sharply, his gaze cutting toward a direction not even within their current Frequency, but somewhere entirely different.
In the Frequency of Vigor.
Waves of white-green brilliance burst like oceans over verdant strings of existence within the Expanse.

Among those strings, the figures of Henry, the Emperor Penguin, Lilith, Erikson, the Primogenitor of Steel, and several others from the Infiniverse Megalos battled Lesser Source Complexity Faceless lifeforms, drawing upon the power of the True Severed Origin Osmontian to wield immense Complexity. They overwhelmed their enemies before any more Dark Towers could be constructed.
Everything had been going smoothly.
Until—
BOOM!
A Dark Tower tore through the veils between Frequencies, blooming in the heart of Vigor. Immediately, enormous Faceless entities emerged- radiating the might of Undeniable Telos Prime Sources.
At the forefront stood none other than Giuseppe!
The white bar on his head had hidden his face beneath the full suit of a Faceless lifeform as he was shining with lividity and rage as he roared.
"You're his people?! Followers of Noah Osmont? You'll be dragged into the endless agony of the Wheel!"
HUUM!
Behind him and three other Telos Prime Source beings, black-and-white Wheels of Existence exploded into motion, emitting a horrifying pull toward Henry and the others.
A horrific, slow grinding pull.
"RAA!"
The Emperor Penguin let out an enraged roar as its clone's weavings, and even the faint thread connecting to its main body, were dragged toward the spinning black and white Wheels.
It wasn't the only one. Everyone felt it, that strange, eerie sensation as if their very weavings were about to be swallowed by the Dead True Sources of Existence and lost forever.
A terrifying moment!
But then...
"A mere pawn actually dares?!"
A young voice rang out.

It was none other than Henry Osmont who stepped forward, his features uncannily similar to the True Severed Origin Osmontian. When Giuseppe saw him, he might as well have been looking at a younger version of Noah.
Rage overtook him as he locked onto Henry, focusing the Wheel's pull entirely on this single figure.
"Are you his progeny?! A child of that man?! I'll torture you the most!"
His voice was wild and chaotic, but before he could say another word, Henry's body ignited with a white-gold brilliance and proceeded to cover everyone behind him in radiant light.
White gold.
The True Flames of the Singed bloomed!
From the Son of the one who pioneered the True Source of the Singed, its power now bloomed.
He was young, yes- but the weavings of Nepotism among others made the impossible possible.

Even if it wasn't entirely his own, the power of a True Source flowed from him. And with it, he clashed head-on against the ghastly light of the Dead Wheels of Existence and entirely absolved the devouring force towards those he was with!

chapters.title: Chapter 3644 Existence! III
paragraphs: The weavings of Giuseppe burned with brilliance as black and white wheels were spiraling around him- even though he felt like he was going mad at this point.

The one he hated, and had already died from once- Noah Osmont...he had his people spread out across Frequencies. He had a Progeny. And the Despondent One had sent Giuseppe right toward them! He gave the simple command- draw them in through the Wheels of Existence.
A command Giuseppe should have been able to carry out without too many problems.
And yet...
And yet...!
"You are his fucking progeny! Why the hell are you erupting with the allure of such complexity?!"

Giuseppe couldn't help but bellow out his misgivings as he felt the effects of the terrifying black and white Wheels behind him, and the three other Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity entities near him...being completely nullified by white-gold flames erupting around Osmont's progeny.
Flames that seemed purer. More complex than even his own Source, and the Sources of the three others beside him combined!
This power seemed even stronger than his father's as it made absolutely no sense.
And yet, Giuseppe didn't know.

The weavings of the True Severed Origin Osmontian could be shared. His son, who had already stepped onto the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed before when he was choosing in the Infiniverse Megalos had his existence opened even further when his father attained the True Source. Through the weavings of Nepotism among others, it had all transferred seamlessly.
And in the middle of it all, the fantastical stellar black brilliance of the True Source of Existence itself stabilized everything.

At this moment, the figure of Henry didn't bother explaining anything. The mere fact that this being had tried to pull the very existence of him and those he held dear was a deed worthy of a cruel, interminable death.
His blue-gold hair flowed serenely in space as he called out calmly.
"Ashes to Ashes. Dust to Dust."
WAA!
Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust!
A terrifying set of words.
The moment they echoed out, white-gold flames bloomed and painted the entire region.
Scratch that- not just the region, but the whole Frequency of Vigor.

The son of the True Severed Origin Osmontian channeled a True Source stemming from his father as he unleashed an attack that bathed entire an frequency in the unquenchable embers of the Flames of the Singed.
The moment these flames touched Giuseppe, the three Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity entities, and the hundreds of faceless life forms just beginning to pour out of the dark tower...
The moment the flames touched them, they began to turn to ash.
No contest. No resistance. No back and forth tug-of-war between complexities. The complexity of a True Source was just far too high.

And so, a scene repeated itself. Giuseppe appeared for a few seconds in the True Frequency of Flames not too long ago and was then eradicated in the next second, incinerated by a blazing sphere from the hands of the True Severed Origin Osmontian.
He appeared again, now for a few seconds in the frequency of Vigorbas the son of the man he hated- the son of the man he didn't know had already taken the one he considered the love of his existence.
That son voiced it out simply- Ashes to Ashes. Dust to Dust lm
And irradiated white-gold flames engulfed an entire frequency of existence.
After that, the figure of Giuseppe and all remaining Faceless Lifeforms...turned to dust.
HUUUM!
The figures of the Emperor Penguin, Lilith, Primogenitor of Steel, and many others had absolutely no words. They just stood there, watching in stunned silence at what had unfolded.
Far away from the Frequency of Vigor, Noah observed the scene coldly, his eyes bathing in the stellar obsidian brilliance of Existence.
"It seems we're getting closer and closer. But for him to try and get my attention by going after my people...I can't say I'm not a little disappointed in such a move, Bob."
His voice was mesmerizing. His weavings were fully connected to the Infiniverse Megalos as he supported its efforts in tracking Bob across the Frequencies.

In his mind, the voice of the Great Usurper continued to echo- giving new, updated locations by the moment, and Noah passed them to the Infiniverse Megalos as her gaze swept through frequency after frequency that had anything to do with Bob's past weavings.
It was like a twisted game of existential hide-and-seek.
But the one hiding had sent assassins after his son and others he cared about.
And Noah's patience was wearing very thin.

Even the Loot Boxes of Existence regained from the weavings of Giuseppe and the three other Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity entities...didn't feel all that satisfying. Not with Bob feeling so close and beginning to get desperate!
The search was nearing its end.
Across the weavings of Existence...

Across an interminable, dark void where all frequencies could be accessed and many sections of the Wheel of Existence could be reached if one took a step in the right direction and had the complexity to traverse it.
This was the space Noah had arrived at when he first Truly Severed his existence.
He called it The Weave.
A void of interconnecting webs stretching endlessly, extremely difficult for even Sources to navigate. Only those who had obtained a True Source could traverse it freely.
Through the Weave, one could take a few steps with the right complexity and be able to traverse multiple frequencies.
And Noah was doing just that, guiding one of his bodies toward the Convergence Point of all the weavings of the Wheel.
An area rumored to hold an unknown number of Legends locked in battle against Dead Things.
He felt himself getting ever closer as he focused on his entanglements—trying to connect to those of the Beyonder so he could appear wherever her weavings were in the Infinite Ravines.
After all, when entering a new place...
Wasn't it better to have a local?

chapters.title: Chapter 3645 Existence! IV
paragraphs: To have a local when entering a new place.

These were Noah's thoughts as he had this body take on the majority of the weavings of the True Source of the Singed and prepared to have this Source pulled into this place and locked down there if need be, as the Great Beyonder uttered.
Because under the umbrella of the Absolute Complex True Source that was the Wheel of Existence, Noah felt that even a sliver of the True Source of Existence would be enough, and he had all of it.

The True Source of Existence- something he had only just begun to grasp. Jumping from a Pathway straight into a True Source, or exerting its brilliance on Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter was just the tip of the iceberg.
It had even allowed him to begin thinking of the final Source he would design for his True Source Atlas of Existence- one that would encompass all three states of existence!
So, while the True Source of the Singed neared the musings of the Infinite Ravines, the True Source of Existence...
"Oh?"
The body of Noah, burning with the white-gold flames of the Singed, turned and gazed toward a certain direction extremely far from where he stood.
There...
"Found you."
A Dead Thing had been discovered.
The game of hide-and-seek was ending.
In the Prime Frequency of the Abyss.
There were many Prime Frequencies out there, but this one held the fewest number of existences by a staggering margin.
It didn't have countless quintillions of beings stretched across the Megalos and Expanse.
No Pantheons, Omniverses, or Dreadlands bursting with life.
Across the entire Prime Frequency of the Abyss, there were approximately 10,000 entities.
That's it.

Each one a was unique being that had managed to survive and thrive in an environment defined by manic, desolate weavings of existence. All 10,000 were Pioneers of Existence or Source Complexity entities.
In this place, vibrations of existence shredded perception and sanity. Reality bent and twisted, drifting outside of linear time and Euclidean space.

Violet-dark strings of existence threaded with spinning spikes stretched across vast, unfathomable regions. Some of these maddening strings clustered into massive structures that embodied both horror and wonder.
Simply existing here, standing still, could unravel, bend, or deform your very being unless your Source or Pathway protected you.
And if your existence could protect you, something strange would begin to happen.
Echoes.
Echoes of your own existence would glimmer in and out of space and time- phantom versions of yourself flickering with possible futures and probable pasts.
Echoes of Existence.
They were a reminder of just how terrifying and powerfully unique this frequency was. Aside from Hell Terra Firma, no other frequency matched its blend of isolation and complexity.
At this moment.
Upon a massive, naturally formed structure known by locals as the Spiral Dissonant Lexicon.
A winding staircase-like monument that extended across the Megalos and into the Expanse, looping endlessly, stretching from the top to the very bottom of the Prime Frequency of the Abyss...
Entirely violet in color, pulsing with tendrils of Entropy, Chaos, and Destruction.
Bob sat on one of its stairs- stairs that alone extended for light-years.
And as he sat, two Echoes of Bob manifested- violet, illusory versions of himself standing, flying, or moving elsewhere.
Every few seconds, more Echoes appeared in different positions, showing him taking other possible actions.
This happened to every entity who survived the unraveling weavings of this frequency.
Bob's bold figure overlooked storming violet-black weavings of existence, the air tinged with violet lightning and flames that coasted across light-years.

"In my Wheel of Existence, I had a frequency just like this. I was born in it. Its weavings were stronger, heavier, and much more dreadful than even here. Only a hundred of us survived and thrived in that entire frequency. Can you imagine that? A hundred complex beings in a whole frequency of existence? The loneliness, the desolation, the level of power, and the potential of such beings. In such a place, to find companionship, to have a family...you would be unfathomably lucky."
Bob's voice was tinged with melancholy.
From the gaps of existence not far away, Noah had arrived at some unknown time.
His gaze was cold and filled with interminable brilliance as he examined the uniqueness of this Prime Frequency. Around him, violet-purple Echoes of himself already began to manifest.
One Echo looked back with tyranny in his eyes. Another floated toward Bob, roaring before dispersing, replaced by more phantom selves.

Noah looked at the massive winding staircases larger than countless Omniverses stacked together. He and Bob stood on a single spiral of a structure simmering with lightning and flame- a representation of chaos and destruction itself.
He walked calmly as Bob continued.

"I find it unique that the same, or similar frequencies appear across different Wheels. It shows that, in the end, everything stems from the same Source. That we're all connected through something larger we don't yet understand."
Bob's voice turned philosophical, his thoughts drifting to times long gone.

Echoes of himself appeared and disappeared, while Noah's body was now surrounded by the scintillating stellar black radiance of the True Source of Existence. He finally spoke, turning away from Bob, staring at the violent beauty of this place.
"You sent your Dead Things after my son. And my people. You and I have been clashing since before then as everything was fine. That action...disappointed me deeply."

"I sensed something closing in. Something narrowing my possibilities into a single, inevitable confrontation. So I tried to buy time. Gain more leverage if I could. Their lives wouldn't have been in true danger. I would've kept them in my Wheel until I achieved my goal."
He spoke calmly. Almost as if talking to an old friend or colleague.
Bob nodded with understanding, even smiled.

"I sensed something closing in. Something narrowing my possibilities into a single, inevitable confrontation. So I tried to buy time. Gain more leverage if I could. Their lives wouldn't have been in true danger. I would've kept them in my Wheel until I achieved my goal."
Dreadful words.
Noah's eyes flashed coldly.
Echoes around him erupted with obsidian flame and then vanished.
Leverage.
That's all Bob considered his son and his people.
Sensing Noah's rising fury, Bob shook his head and looked away, gazing at his tentacled limbed hands.

I carry quintillions of souls because of such an action as they are screaming in my ears every second for the past eons."

"I've learned. I won't subject more beings to death and pain. I only need access to the core- a possible pathway to something neither you nor I could comprehend. Some Wheels don't even have that pathway. But this one might. Its vibrant complexity could hold a clue to what innervates the Wheels themselves. The Great Usurper must have told you about that, right?"
HUUM!

"I don't need a fight. I don't want anything else. I just need direction. I need to access the True Frequencies that began pulsing after you opened the True Frequency of the Singed. I need time. Nobody, and I repeat- nobody...has to get hurt."
No one has to get hurt.

And he asked, voice sharp as a blade:
"Who are you planning to hurt? If things don't go your way, what leverage do you already have?"
If Bob saw Noah's son and people as leverage once...what else might he be hiding?
Bob nodded lightly.

"I hold with me the musings of multiple Nodes of Existence tied to frequencies. If we remain here, just talk, everything remains intact. But if we go primitive, if we fight, those frequencies will crumble. Countless lives will be lost. And neither of us wants that. Especially not you, friend"

sentences.text: To have a local when entering a new place.

These were Noah's thoughts as he had this body take on the majority of the weavings of the True Source of the Singed and prepared to have this Source pulled into this place and locked down there if need be, as the Great Beyonder uttered.
Because under the umbrella of the Absolute Complex True Source that was the Wheel of Existence, Noah felt that even a sliver of the True Source of Existence would be enough, and he had all of it.
The True Source of Existence- something he had only just begun to grasp.
Jumping from a Pathway straight into a True Source, or exerting its brilliance on Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter was just the tip of the iceberg.
It had even allowed him to begin thinking of the final Source he would design for his True Source Atlas of Existence- one that would encompass all three states of existence!
So, while the True Source of the Singed neared the musings of the Infinite Ravines, the True Source of Existence...
"Oh?"
The body of Noah, burning with the white-gold flames of the Singed, turned and gazed toward a certain direction extremely far from where he stood.
There...
"Found you."
A Dead Thing had been discovered.
The game of hide-and-seek was ending.
In the Prime Frequency of the Abyss.
There were many Prime Frequencies out there, but this one held the fewest number of existences by a staggering margin.
It didn't have countless quintillions of beings stretched across the Megalos and Expanse.
No Pantheons, Omniverses, or Dreadlands bursting with life.
Across the entire Prime Frequency of the Abyss, there were approximately 10,000 entities.
That's it.
Each one a was unique being that had managed to survive and thrive in an environment defined by manic, desolate weavings of existence.
All 10,000 were Pioneers of Existence or Source Complexity entities.
In this place, vibrations of existence shredded perception and sanity.
Reality bent and twisted, drifting outside of linear time and Euclidean space.
Violet-dark strings of existence threaded with spinning spikes stretched across vast, unfathomable regions.
Some of these maddening strings clustered into massive structures that embodied both horror and wonder.
Simply existing here, standing still, could unravel, bend, or deform your very being unless your Source or Pathway protected you.
And if your existence could protect you, something strange would begin to happen.
Echoes.
Echoes of your own existence would glimmer in and out of space and time- phantom versions of yourself flickering with possible futures and probable pasts.
Echoes of Existence.
They were a reminder of just how terrifying and powerfully unique this frequency was.
Aside from Hell Terra Firma, no other frequency matched its blend of isolation and complexity.
At this moment.
Upon a massive, naturally formed structure known by locals as the Spiral Dissonant Lexicon.
A winding staircase-like monument that extended across the Megalos and into the Expanse, looping endlessly, stretching from the top to the very bottom of the Prime Frequency of the Abyss...
Entirely violet in color, pulsing with tendrils of Entropy, Chaos, and Destruction.
Bob sat on one of its stairs- stairs that alone extended for light-years.
And as he sat, two Echoes of Bob manifested- violet, illusory versions of himself standing, flying, or moving elsewhere.
Every few seconds, more Echoes appeared in different positions, showing him taking other possible actions.
This happened to every entity who survived the unraveling weavings of this frequency.
Bob's bold figure overlooked storming violet-black weavings of existence, the air tinged with violet lightning and flames that coasted across light-years.
"In my Wheel of Existence, I had a frequency just like this.
I was born in it.
Its weavings were stronger, heavier, and much more dreadful than even here.
Only a hundred of us survived and thrived in that entire frequency.
Can you imagine that?
A hundred complex beings in a whole frequency of existence?
The loneliness, the desolation, the level of power, and the potential of such beings.
In such a place, to find companionship, to have a family...you would be unfathomably lucky."
Bob's voice was tinged with melancholy.
From the gaps of existence not far away, Noah had arrived at some unknown time.
His gaze was cold and filled with interminable brilliance as he examined the uniqueness of this Prime Frequency.
Around him, violet-purple Echoes of himself already began to manifest.
One Echo looked back with tyranny in his eyes.
Another floated toward Bob, roaring before dispersing, replaced by more phantom selves.
Noah looked at the massive winding staircases larger than countless Omniverses stacked together.
He and Bob stood on a single spiral of a structure simmering with lightning and flame- a representation of chaos and destruction itself.
He walked calmly as Bob continued.
"I find it unique that the same, or similar frequencies appear across different Wheels.
It shows that, in the end, everything stems from the same Source.
That we're all connected through something larger we don't yet understand."
Bob's voice turned philosophical, his thoughts drifting to times long gone.
Echoes of himself appeared and disappeared, while Noah's body was now surrounded by the scintillating stellar black radiance of the True Source of Existence.

"You sent your Dead Things after my son.
And my people.
You and I have been clashing since before then as everything was fine.
That action...disappointed me deeply."
"I sensed something closing in.
Something narrowing my possibilities into a single, inevitable confrontation.
So I tried to buy time.
Gain more leverage if I could.
Their lives wouldn't have been in true danger.
I would've kept them in my Wheel until I achieved my goal."
He spoke calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 3646 Existence V
paragraphs: The coldness in the region of the Prime Frequency of the Abyss was bone-chilling.
In the Spiral Dissonant Lexicon- a massive, stair-like structure extending across this Frequency, the visage of Bob stared calmly at the True Severed Origin Osmontian as he laid out his leverage.
He held multiple Nodes of Existence, each with the power to make or break Frequencies themselves.
Countless lives and weavings of existence resided in each, and he wielded several of these Frequencies as leverage!

And even with all that, he had still sent others to capture Noah's people- just for a little more leverage. Just to be as prepared as he could be as he was this close to finding a way into a True Frequency of Existence. Though unsuccessful in getting more leverage, it revealed his obsession with control in the current moment.
He sighed.

"Friend, I've made some mistakes in my past- many of them, in fact. I'm paying for them even now. I know the dead and the living don't mix. I made the mistake of connecting a dead Wheel of Existence to one that was alive, and I have been paying for that mistake ever since. All those lives." He paused, then offered a rueful chuckle. "What do you humans say? Everybody makes mistakes? And those who learn from them, those who try their best not to repeat them...those are the ones who are truly human."
You humans.
Noah absorbed the words coldly. He remembered the musings of the Alchemist Ashmole who once looked him in the eye and said he wasn't human at all.
With his weavings of the True Source of Existence, he knew well where he stood as he didn't reply to this.
He didn't want a psychological sparring match with the entity before him. So he simply responded, cold and sharp.
"This is a fascinating monologue you've got going. Any chance you're nearing the end?"
His gaze didn't shift. His body was cloaked in a stellar obsidian luster brimming with power and threatening to overflow.
It was the allure of a terrifying True Source of Existence, and it was only getting started! Even Bob seemed to regard it with a glimmer of caution as he gave it a few looks.
Behind Bob, dreadful black-and-white wheels manifested silently as he looked back at Noah and spoke softly.
"You're angry."
Angry?
He was angry?
Noah shook his head.
"No. I'm not angry. I'm pissed."
HUUM!
Around him, the illusory echoes of alternate versions conjured forth, flickers of possibility...stilled.
As if, through sheer will, Noah had frozen even the shifting threads of potential and possibilities spawned by the Prime Frequency of the Abyss.
Bob's expression turned grimmer. He raised his tentacled hands and revealed dazzling Nodes of Existence shimmering between them.

"I really don't want it to come to this. When two unstoppable forces meet, they often choose to clash. But there are other routes. There is dialogue one could have. There is a level of understanding to be given to both sides." His voice softened as he uttered lastly. "I thought, at least, that you would understand."

"Your Wheel of Existence will remain untouched. I just need to see what it is- to confirm something. If it truly leads to what Innervates all Wheels. I just need to find the missing piece. If I do, I can revive a dead Wheel. My actions and every single thing that I am doing right now...they could save countless lives across two whole Wheels of Existence."
He continued, eyes earnest.

"This isn't some grand, evil plan. I'm saving lives. I'm rewriting terrible mistakes, ensuring they never repeat. Why stand in the way of that? Why not simply consider that my path might actually be possible? We could enter a True Frequency of the Wheel together. There, everything would be made clear."
Bob's words were terrifying in their simplicity. He spoke to Noah about imagining a different outcome.
"It could all be so simple," he added, as he plucked a Node from the cluster and held it delicately between two tentacles.
"In every Wheel of Existence, there are always one or more entities that rise above the rest. In your Wheel, there's you and a few others. Anomalies. In mine, there was only me."
He leaned in slightly.
"My complexity is unlike any anomaly you've met. Behind me are two Dead Absolute Complex True Sources. I bear them. They draw from me, and I draw from them- even in death."
Then his voice dropped low.
"But more than that, you remember, don't you? I have my own Source."
WAA!
"Khaos. I never lied about that, friend. I've been slowly regaining clarity on it. So while you may have attained a True Source in the midst of this chaos somehow, I hold the equivalent of three."
His voice now held weight, grief, and pride mixed alongside everything else!

"We could fight. But even on my worst day, I doubt I'd lose to you. And if we do fight? The death toll will be obscene. It will make me infinitely sadder. But I can bear the burden of death. I don't think you can."
As he spoke, he raised the Node of a normal Frequency like a man drawing a final line in the sand.
His eyes held no cruelty, no triumph.
Only sincerity.
As he looked at Noah, he waited for the choice.
The decision.
As always, it came down to a choice.
And in that moment, the visage of the True Severed Origin Osmontian looked toward Bob with chilling apathy.
A response. A verdict!
"The dead and the living do not mix."
No matter how sweet the words Bob used.
No matter how twisted his logic.
No matter how simple he made it all sound.
"If we just do this," or "Let me into the true frequency and I'll find the answer"...
None of it mattered.
The core truth remained unchanged.
The dead and the living do not mix.
The moment these words were spoken, Bob sighed and closed his eyes...
And crushed the Node of Existence in his hands!

chapters.title: Chapter 3647 Existence! VI
paragraphs: The crushing of a Node of Existence.
A Node was no trivial thing. And when Bob crushed it, he didn't just use brute strength.
There was a flash of silver-white radiance. One could see it clearly—he had called upon the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence to achieve this terrifying effect.
And Bob didn't just crush a Node.
His weavings surged. Behind him, within the Spiral Dissonant Lexicon, a massive illusory screen appeared—revealing the weavings of the Frequency of Gold.

Surrounded by endless golden brilliance, this was a realm of unfathomable wealth and beauty. And in the next moment, the screen showed the actual flow of the Wheel within this frequency...beginning to fracture.
Lifeforms began to appear on the screens—multitudes of them—as reality itself shattered around them like fragile glass.
When this glass broke, it didn't do so quietly.
Many entities, to their horror, found that they couldn't channel any power at all. Their connection to the Wheel had been cut. Severed!
They were locked out of reality.
Space cracked. Fissures spread. Creatures in the path of these splits were torn apart—eyes dimming of all brilliance—fading shortly after.
The illusory screen behind Bob shifted rapidly. It showed countless regions of the Megalos—the grand expanse of the Frequency of Gold, which he had just erased with a single crushed Node.
And he had done it...with his eyes closed.
Essence of desolation and regret radiated from him, as if he truly hadn't wanted to take this step.
"I hear them."
His voice echoed out—low, mournful.
But Noah stared at him with eyes colder than the Abyss. Any remnants of goodwill, any flicker of redemption that might've once existed was gone.
This being had just made a conscious choice to destroy an entire Frequency of Existence.
And Noah already knew what he was about to say next.

"That didn't need to happen, my friend. And it still doesn't. I have a dozen more Nodes of Existence. This can stop right now. Let's not descend into something primitive. Let's rise above our baser selves. Let's do something...we'll actually be proud of."
His words were polished. Persuasive. Coated in idealism.
But toward this creature who had just annihilated an entire Frequency of Existence, Noah raised his hand and formed a fist.
Within that fist, a convergence of blinding, stellar obsidian brilliance began to bloom.
The weight of a True Source of Existence gathered there as he said, coldly.
"Echoes of the Unwritten."
HUUM!
Echoes of the Unwritten.
Four words. New, even to Noah. And by the look on his face—new to Bob, too.
Bob's brows furrowed.
And then...his eyes widened.
The illusory screen behind him—once dark and lifeless from the destruction it displayed—suddenly flickered to life. The events it had shown began to play in reverse.
Reality, once fractured, began to reform.
Shattered space knitted itself back together. Entities returned to life. The Frequency of Gold...healed.
It all unfolded uniquely and rapidly. In seconds, the entire destruction sequence had been undone. The screen vanished.
And in Bob's two tentacles...the Node of Existence he had crushed reappeared—reborn from a blinding singularity.
Bob's eyes flared with light, staring at the unbroken Node now resting in his hand.
It was there.
As real as it had ever been.

The sheer impossibility of it made his inner complexity buzz. He turned and summoned another set of limbs, weaving more complexity into being. Another illusory screen appeared, showing the Frequency of Gold once more.
Intact.
Untouched.
Bob stared at it, his expression growing darker and more severe.
Far in the distance, Noah stood surrounded by rippling waves of True Source of Existence, his body blazing with obsidian radiance.
He spoke again.
"Existence is a unique thing. When one attains the True Source of Existence, one of the abilities it bestows is something called... Echoes of the Unwritten."
HUUM!

"It grants the power to undo—or redo—any event in existence. There are limitations, sure...but I don't need to tell you that. All you need to know is this- from here on out? You can destroy any Frequency of Existence you want. And right after... I'll undo that event."
Noah's words were horrifying in their certainty. What he did was not something that one could attribute the reversal of time or even the reversal of Causality itself.
What he undid were the very weavings of existence themselves!
As he spoke, the True Source of Existence pulsed within him as it continued communicating with him. Guiding him.
This was the truth of the True Source.
Attaining it was not the end.
Attaining the True Source of Existence wasn't the final step. It was only the beginning.
The weavings of reality were vast—beyond imagination. And only after one claimed the True Source could they truly awaken to the infinite possibilities they could undertake with it.
To the alterations that could be made.
The only real limitation was complexity.

Because Noah's complexity had reached such terrifying heights, he had become capable of using Echoes of the Unwritten—able to reach into the strands of what could've been, and force one strand into being.
He had looked into the branches of probability where Bob destroyed and didn't destroy the Frequency of Gold, and chosen the path he preferred.
The one where the Frequency remained.
And just like that...he had become capable of undoing anything someone in front of him did—so long as it hadn't happened too far in the past.
Even if the action hadn't taken place right in front of him.
So long as it was recent?
He could unravel it.
It was terrifying. It was a sort of power that made even him take a pause when the weavings of the True Source of Existence spoke to him!
A power that made Bob pause—still holding the Node of Existence that just moments ago had been crushed and lost.
And now...it was perfectly whole again.
Meanwhile, Noah's body continued to shine with an even more scintillating stellar obsidian brilliance.
The True Source of Existence within him was only just waking up.
And it was beginning to show itself with terrifying fervor.

Bob stared at it, his expression growing darker and more severe.
Far in the distance, Noah stood surrounded by rippling waves of True Source of Existence, his body blazing with obsidian radiance.
He spoke again.
"Existence is a unique thing.
When one attains the True Source of Existence, one of the abilities it bestows is something called...
Echoes of the Unwritten."
HUUM!
"It grants the power to undo—or redo—any event in existence.
There are limitations, sure...but I don't need to tell you that.
All you need to know is this- from here on out?
You can destroy any Frequency of Existence you want.
And right after...
I'll undo that event."
Noah's words were horrifying in their certainty.
What he did was not something that one could attribute the reversal of time or even the reversal of Causality itself.
What he undid were the very weavings of existence themselves!
As he spoke, the True Source of Existence pulsed within him as it continued communicating with him.
Guiding him.
This was the truth of the True Source.
Attaining it was not the end.
Attaining the True Source of Existence wasn't the final step.
It was only the beginning.
The weavings of reality were vast—beyond imagination.
And only after one claimed the True Source could they truly awaken to the infinite possibilities they could undertake with it.
To the alterations that could be made.
The only real limitation was complexity.

Because Noah's complexity had reached such terrifying heights, he had become capable of using Echoes of the Unwritten—able to reach into the strands of what could've been, and force one strand into being.
He had looked into the branches of probability where Bob destroyed and didn't destroy the Frequency of Gold, and chosen the path he preferred.
The one where the Frequency remained.
And just like that...he had become capable of undoing anything someone in front of him did—so long as it hadn't happened too far in the past.
Even if the action hadn't taken place right in front of him.
So long as it was recent?
He could unravel it.
It was terrifying.
It was a sort of power that made even him take a pause when the weavings of the True Source of Existence spoke to him!
A power that made Bob pause—still holding the Node of Existence that just moments ago had been crushed and lost.
And now...it was perfectly whole again.
Meanwhile, Noah's body continued to shine with an even more scintillating stellar obsidian brilliance.
The True Source of Existence within him was only just waking up.
And it was beginning to show itself with terrifying fervor.

chapters.title: Chapter 3648 Existence! VII
paragraphs: Bob silently stared at the Node of Existence in his hands.
It had been destroyed by him moments ago, and yet in the next instant, it was wholly undone in a fantastical way.
He looked at the Node as if, deep down, he knew this wasn't some lesser reversion or reversal of causality. That this was the genuine undoing of existence itself!
"You've found yourself a truly terrifying Source, my friend."
His voice was honest.
He let the words linger as the action Noah had just performed was something that demanded, even from someone as horrifying as Bob, silent applause.
"But still..."
Bob's eyes flickered. Behind him, the black and white wheels began to turn, radiating an eerie aura of power.
Even they, however, remained subdued as from Bob himself, a hazy violet light began to bloom.
Violet.
An extremely dense and pure violet erupted around his body. It was the reveal of the true weavings of none other than...
"Khaos."
Bob spoke lightly.
His eyes held a trace of reluctance as he shook his head and continued.

"I actually did my best not to utilize the True Source of Khaos within another Wheel of Existence. I didn't attempt to draw upon this Source because even though it's mine, even though my weavings manipulate it...the effect it has on existence is too widespread. Too chaotic. It taints and ruins the very flow of the Wheel, even if I never wish it to. It causes an eruption of absolute entropic energy that leaks across Frequencies. I did not want to use this True Source. But you, my friend...you're forcing my hand."
The violet light became unbearably intense as Bob closed his eyes.

His eyes were already closed as if he knew the answer. And even though he didn't need to physically look at Noah, his voice echoed out clearly, surrounded by irradiant, stellar obsidian weavings of authorial force.
"To fight is to be primitive. Even now, dialogue and understanding would be ideal. Even now, I ask again...can we come to an understanding?"

His eyes were already closed as if he knew the answer. And even though he didn't need to physically look at Noah, his voice echoed out clearly, surrounded by irradiant, stellar obsidian weavings of authorial force.
"We are way past understanding."
A simple answer.
And toward such an expected answer, Bob had his own.
He whispered as if he were cradling a newly born baby.
"Fractal Collapse."
HUUM!
Space around him began to crack like a spiderweb.
No, not space. What was cracking and breaking apart was Existence itself!
Around Bob, reality shattered as if it had never been there to begin with. And in its place, the unraveling of Khaos spread.
"You can undo events within the bounds of Existence. But what if Existence turns chaotic- becomes absent entirely? Would you still be able to undo the weavings then?"
Bob spoke serenely. Only an instant had passed, and yet the cracking, the shattering of Existence, had already spread across multiple light years.
And it didn't look to be slowing down in the slightest- it began to consume the Frequency itself.

The Spiral Dissonant Lexicon beneath them instantly shattered, becoming pieces of dissonant violet brilliance. The weavings of the Abyss seethed, their very existence being torn apart as they seemed to cheer it on!
Around Noah and Bob, the entire landscape turned into one of immeasurable Khaos.
Bob's form vibrated. His limbs exploded into kaleidoscopic chaos- countless tentacles spreading through the collapsing, unwinding fabric of reality.

"I didn't want to use Khaos. Because as you can see, once entropy is unleashed, its effects run wild. Soon, this entire Frequency of the Abyss will be covered. After that, Khaos will spill into other Frequencies. The more that are consumed, the closer we come to something unbearably unique. I'll tell you now, so you can possibly stop it in time. Once enough weavings of Khaos have spread, there will be a Paradoxical Collapse of Certainty. Existence itself will begin to unravel on a massive scale. The Flow of Existence will collapse. And within the bounds of True Khaos...even True Sources may begin to doubt themselves."
Bob uttered terrifying words as his response to Noah's unwinding of an event was releasing his True Source in kind.
Noah's weavings shimmered as he looked upon the continuing collapse- the chaotic, barely visible weavings of Existence that consumed the entire Frequency.
Reality had become an array of unstable weavings that were haphazard, empty, or undone.
And yet, even so...
HUUM!
Existence was still present.
No matter how chaotic it had become under Bob's influence, it was still there- fractured or not.
And so long as it had not entirely collapsed...
Noah raised a single finger toward the shattering existence above.
A finger that pulsed with an incandescent singularity of stellar obsidian brilliance.
On it surged endless waves of the True Source of Existence. And his answer to the collapsing chaos around him?
It was a simple one.
"Existential Proliferation."
WAA!
His raised hand pulsed. From the singularity of stellar obsidian mass, a sea of existence erupted.
If Bob was collapsing and erasing existence itself?
Then Noah would drown everything in the overflowing brilliance of his Weavings of Existence!
From that single finger, the seas of stellar obsidian Existence poured out- flooding billions of light years in an instant. They continued to spread rapidly across the Frequency.
Even his son, wielding another True Source, had once bathed an entire Frequency. How could Noah not do something far more?
BZZT!
The collapsing, chaotic Existence stalled. The spiderweb-like fractures began to fill.
The torn, decimated weavings of reality—like a ruined painting—were made anew.
Yet Bob's influence lingered. Khaos continued to spread madly.
More spiderwebs appeared—Existence itself fracturing. But each time, mere moments later...seas of billowing obsidian Existence surged forth and filled the gaps.
A terrifying display of mastery.
Bob looked once more at Noah and sighed.

"I collapse Existence and introduce uncertainty. And you try to restore it. But how long can this continue before the Wheel's very flow is affected and collapses? I never wanted to become primitive. But if you force me, my friend...there is no going back."
A final warning.

And Noah, radiating waves of stellar obsidian Existence—became wholly immersed in it. Behind him, massive wings unfurled, made of blinding stellar light. Halos of obsidian radiance spun behind him like unfathomable disks, ready to unleash the beams of the True Source of Existence at any moment.
His eyes—no longer eyes—had become singularities of the blackest Megalos.
And with rising majesty in his voice, he replied simply.
"Let's. Fucking. GO."
HUUM!
Boundless authority rose as the True Severed Origin Osmontian abandoned all hope of diplomacy.
The figure of Bob stopped holding back. The smile faded from his face. His jaws unhinged—stretching end to end—as his limbs exploded outward like a kaleidoscope.
BOOM!
A single punch.
And it was enough to collapse the weavings of Existence nearby—except those around Noah. The punch's force carried them directly into The Weave.
SIUU!
Even the blackness of the Weave shattered. When Bob retracted his arm, Noah's obsidian halos unleashed beams of Existence, restoring everything in their path.
They reappeared in a new place.
In a Frequency.
No longer the Abyss.
Bob's single punch had shattered everything nearby. Noah had filled it back in. But the blow had already hurled them through an entirely different Frequency of Existence!
This would be a battle of unfathomable proportions.
On one side, a budding entity, just now awakening to the full depth of a newly claimed True Source.
On the other, an ancient being, recovering his complexity- his Source too unstable for most to even comprehend.

These two cosmic forces now clashed under the umbrella of an Absolute Complex True Source—one seeking to reach the core and ignite it, not to toy with it, but to find something he desperately needed. The other? He fought to protect what was left after entire Frequencies had already collapsed. After entire Wheels of Existence had shattered behind a man who sought even more change.
But the only change he was destined to find...was the desperation to restore what he could not.
And with that...all he would bring was the collapse of another Wheel of Existence as it would be disastrous!
Each entity had their reasons, their ideals.
But at this moment, all that remained was their complexity.
And their complexity alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 3649 Existence! VIII
paragraphs: As a terrifying battle erupted- one that could shift its landscape from frequency to frequency at any moment, there were very few who could claim to have witnessed it.
Very few.
And yet, from the frequency Noah and Bob had just departed.
The Frequency of the Abyss.
An illusory nine-pointed circle began to bloom high above the nearly decimated Spiral Dissonant Lexicon.

The circle pulsed with unique weavings and interlocking sockets. It was an Enneagram, glowing with unstable threads of a Wheel. It almost resembled and pulsed with an air of a True Source, but it was far too chaotic.
Unstable.
Incomplete.
As if parts of it had been missing all along, only now beginning to be made whole again.
To become what it was truly meant to be.
From the center of that shining illusory star, the figure known as the Peacemaker emerged.
His entire form flickered, ethereal- more suggestion than substance, as if he wasn't truly here at all.
He looked down at the decimation of existence- at the scars of Khaos that had spread briefly through this place. Then, he shook his head.
His complexity wasn't enough, not for this. As much as he longed to act, to intervene, he simply wasn't ready.

So he continued his search, looking for the pieces he needed to complete his Enneagram. And maybe, just maybe, he would one day enact the kind of Peace that wouldn't require him to look over his shoulder for eons to come...wondering whether a certain bald, tentacle-limbed being was still alive or dead.
Well, even more dead than he was already dead!
Just as quickly as he came, the Peacemaker vanished.
The illusory nine-pointed star that had heralded his arrival flickered out of existence.
And amidst all these fantastical weavings, there was one more witness.

This being's soul and will were scattered across many points, many spaces- but now, in this moment, he focused himself. He began a thorough assault, stretching his fragmented soul into the weavings of two Absolute Complex True Sources.
Well...dead ones, anyway.
In a silent frequency untouched by battle, the figure of the Great Usurper sat atop a black tower. His gaze was narrowed, filled with somber concentration.
He had sensed the beginning of a battle between two unfathomable entities—and amidst the chaos, he struck.
He would use this instability to his advantage.
His target? The countless dead souls sealed within the Dead Wheels of Existence that Bob carried. If he could claim them...
He might disrupt Bob's usage of them and granting Osmont an edge.
Or...Bob might prove powerful enough to cleanse the intrusion entirely.
But the Usurper could feel it- these countless lifeforms, wailing in pain within the Dead Wheels- they weren't just echoes. They were components of the Wheels themselves.
If he could take them all...
With their power—alongside the chaotic complexity of existence—couldn't he command the Dead Wheels himself?
It was dangerous.
After all, the one he was attempting to siphon from, this being called Bob....was the most complex entity within this Wheel of Existence.
Even more than Osmont.
And his power was growing rapidly.
But still, the Great Usurper moved.
Because if Bob, the Dead Thing, held such terrifying power...
One had to wonder...
How powerful were the other dead things the legends whispered about and fought against?
The ones whose names were forgotten...
The ones the protectors of the Wheel held nightmares of in the Infinite Ravines?
"The Infinite Ravines..."
Noah's voice echoed out softly.
His body—housing the True Source of the Singed—arrived at a uniquely strange junction within The Weave.
After traversing at a terrifying velocity—fast enough to cross from one Frequency to another in an instant—he felt as though he'd passed the equivalent of hundreds of millions of Frequencies.
It was unreal.
But now, he stood at a threshold.
The darkness of The Weave collapsed ahead of him into an expanse of white.
Endless white.

Yet it wasn't merely a transition from black to white. It was a convergence—a fusion of such incredible complexity and brilliance, that the moment he stepped out of the blackened Weave, he would be transported somewhere wholly new.
A place one could only enter with a True Source.
The Infinite Ravines.
When Noah finally arrived at this point, he saw that taking a single step into the junction between black and white could send him to vastly different places within the Ravines.
But he was focused.
Focused on the entanglement, the one between him and the Great Beyonder.
As he contemplated his next move, it came—a pull from his True Source. It told him that a very specific position on his left side held the path.
Any step—except that one—would send him somewhere impossibly far from her.
Incalculable in distance, even if measured in the scale of entire Frequencies.
This proved something undeniable.
The Infinite Ravines wasn't just an endpoint or gateway of an Absolute Complex True Source.
It was a dimensionally vast space!
Vaster than the concept of distance itself.
As he stood there, Noah's distinction of the Weaver of Existence buzzed to life.
And of all the distinctions, this stood above the rest, empowered by the True Source of Existence itself.
He held the True Source of Existence. So...why shouldn't his distinction reveal everything about the existence he saw?
His eyes shimmered, constantly feeding back information.
Dozens of prompts appeared and vanished.
Even the correct step, the one that would take him to the Great Beyonder, was highlighted by his Weaver of Existence with a green arrow flashing above it.
And so...
He breathed out.
And he stepped forward.
Existence buzzed.
It flickered.
He moved forward, illuminating his weavings using the True Source of the Singed alone to anchor himself here.
His Distinction buzzed again, feeding him critical truths of his surrounding Existence.
|Part of your Weavings of Existence have taken a nearly irreversible leap away from the Loose Cover of an Absolute Complex True Source.|
|Part of your Weavings of Existence are stepping into the Strict Cover of an Absolute Complex True Source.|
|The light of your True Source is capable of surviving the transfer into the area designated as the Infinite Ravines.|
The information flowed freely as Noah felt the subtle, infinite shifts.
He could feel the freedom within strictness, the strength hidden within fragility.
It was paradoxical...and yet, he was drawing closer.
Closer to the place where the weavings of the Great Beyonder awaited.
|The Weavings of your Existence are arriving at a region within the Infinite Ravines.|
|This region has been analyzed and distinguished as the Hollow Cascade of Reversed Causality. |
| Here, an unknown Wild True Source permeates the Hollow Cascade. The Causality of Existence is reversed constantly. |
|Cause follows effect. Enemies may bleed before they are struck. Time flows backward. Weavings unwind.|
|Your True Source must adapt, or your very existence will become unwound.|
