chapters.title: Chapter 3669 Ashes IV.
paragraphs: Every action had an equal and opposite reaction.
Every choice had a consequence.
Noah stared at the man- a being who had become a Dead Thing- someone who had made countless choices across a long life, all of them leading here.
To this.
A prison of Noah's making. And unless something drastic happened like shattering another Dead Absolute Complex True Source-getting out would be nearly impossible.
Yet Bob remained calm, surrounded by the weavings of the True Source of Ruination, his mind remarkably intact. He called out, his voice unwavering.
"My daughter. I do all of this for my daughter. She's locked within this Absolute Complex True Source of Existence."
His eyes flicked to the black Wheel of Existence that hovered beside him, its weavings unbearably complex. At the center, untouched, was a soul he had never dared to disturb.

"Others- others can be called out and turned into Faceless Lifeforms. But her... I've never touched her soul. I've never even spoken to her. I feared tainting her with death. But if I can find that... I should be able to reinvigorate the Dead Wheel of Existence. Everyone within it would be saved. It's such a simple act. Harmless. This... this is all I seek. I'm just a father seeking a sliver of hope for his daughter."
Bob's voice rang with conviction, as if he had built every ounce of his existence toward this moment.
Noah's expression didn't shift. Cold. Unmoved.
The fable of the Scorpion and the Frog echoed in his mind.
This man, this thing...would sting and kill them all, no matter how sweetly he spoke.
But Noah still asked.
"What is that? The thing you and the one who destroyed your Wheel were chasing—what is it?"
He needed to know the identity of this unknown force that powerful beings were chasing.

The reason he hadn't believed Bob wasn't just distrust—it was because the entity who had destroyed Bob's Wheel eons ago...they had come seeking the same thing. They hadn't intended to destroy. They had come for that.
And yet, destruction followed.
So how could Bob expect anything different?
Still, Noah sought answers.
Bob turned toward him, his eyes aglow with weary truth.

"It is unknown. Many call it different names. No one knows what it truly is. But we believe that unique Absolute Complex True Sources... they act as pathways. Some call it The Loom. Others call it the Pirene of Existence. Everyone has their name for it, and yet... no one has ever found or seen it. But I believe its pathway is here. I just..."
He trailed off.
All he needed was to reach the core weavings of the Wheel of Existence.
But Noah could never allow it. The risk was too great.
That, too, was a choice.
And because no one ever truly knew the consequences of even the smallest decisions, Noah raised the Cradle of Purity high above the endless prison of Ruination.
He was about to make a choice of his own.
He had to.
Because in this very moment, his body—traveling alongside the Origin Singed—flickered across countless frequencies of Existence until they finally arrived...
At hell.
BOOM!
BOOM!
The Frequency of Light shook violently. Its very fabric teetered on collapse. What once brimmed with vibrant auras and silver-white brilliance had now been reduced to dust.
Minutes ago, the Expanse had been filled with life. The strings of existence—tense and bright.
Now?
Fractured.
Broken.
Drained of light!
The Flow. The Weavings. The very essence of the Frequency of Light—over half of it—was gone. Devoured.
Every Pioneer. Every Existence-Severing entity. Every Source, whether it be Lesser or Prime.
Gone.
Annihilated by the two Dead Things who had arrived here after Bob.
And they revealed, in perfect clarity, the true nature of what Dead Things do.
Noah sensed them from afar.
One was a massive gray, crescent-shaped Wheel exuding tentacles lined with razor teeth. It consumed everything.
He dubbed it the Gray-Wheeled Tentacled Dead Thing.
The other... a humanoid woman.
Her figure was barely two meters tall, and yet her hair—a storm of darkness—extended across light-years, vast enough to match a Megalos.
Her strands consumed everything they touched. Noah dubbed her...the Heran Megalos Dead Thing!
Their Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity surged higher with each ounce of life drained.
White gold flames of the Wheel innately washed down like a sea to try and scorch them, but they withstood these flames with their Dead True Sources!
"Choices, and consequences."
Noah's voice was quiet. Final.
Beside him, the Origin Singed stood still, watching the devastation with grim resolve. He said nothing.
Then he moved.
A streak of burning light—he launched himself toward the two Dead Things, aiming to stop their annihilation of the Frequency of Light before they moved on to consume others.
And they would.
They would devour endlessly. Satisfying their True Sources... and then continuing anyway.
Noah turned his gaze upon the collapsing landscape and spoke softly.
"Echoes of the Unwritten."
HUUM!
The True Source of Existence erupted from him again—its necessity growing with each new calamity.
Stellar obsidian brilliance gushed outward, bathing light-years of space. From the torn remnants of the Frequency of Light, something began to return.
Life.
Weavings.
Form.
The destroyed and decimated structures—countless quintillions—began to reform. The Megalos of this frequency slowly returning to their former state.
As this grand process took hold, Noah turned his head toward the two distant Dead Things.
The Origin Singed had barely reached them.
The body of the Origin Singed flared, erupting with the luminous Pillar of Concordance as he shouted:
"Moshata! Bizax! Our fight isn't over!"
He knew their names.
He had battled them for eons.
He couldn't afford to let them persist!
Their presence alone—even without feeding—was causing the Wheel's flow to collapse. Rapidly.
They had to die. And quickly.
Noah's body radiated the profound power of the True Source of Existence as he was undoing a cataclysm and restoring a Frequency.
And then, he also began to radiate with crimson Ruination, calling out lightly.
"Existential Unraveling."
Ruination unfurled.
Instantly, crimson lines shot out from Noah—trillions of them—each one alive, lashing toward both Dead Things in the distance!

Instantly, crimson lines shot out from Noah—trillions of them—each one alive, lashing toward both Dead Things in the distance!

chapters.title: Chapter 3670 Ashes V
paragraphs: Existential Unraveling.
Noah's body burned with the True Source of Ruination as he unleashed a terrifying capability.
The True Source of Ruination could identify the foundational "threads" that composed a being- their memories, identities, concepts, and pull them apart with eerie precision into absolute ruin.
And so, it released those crimson threads.
Threads capable of isolating the weak points within True Sources of Existence and unraveling them, leaving the target in a state of unbeing.
And as they did, his chest radiated a terrifying white-gold brilliance- the Cradle of Purity ready to receive any unraveled threads of existence and devour them whole.
SKEEE!
The two Dead Things roared with maddened fervor, their very beings thrumming in an excited state they hadn't felt in millions of years.
Because, for the first time, they were inside the depths of the Wheel of Existence.
Until now, they had fought only within the Infinite Ravines.
This moment—this choice—was everything they had been dreaming of, coming true in the span of an instant.
The moment the Origin Singed chose to fully return to the folds of the Wheel.
The two of them had been present in the Gateway Domus he protected at the time. They'd followed his returning Weavings—like a path carved just for them.
They had left behind three other Dead Things in that Gateway Domus, unfortunate enough to not be within its folds when the Origin Singed made his return.
They would forever regret it.
Because, by now, that Gateway Domus was likely being taken—merged into another.
So, their entrance into the Wheel of Existence would not go quietly. Their Dead True Sources of Existence erupted in full, ready to stand against the Origin Singed they once knew, and...
BOOM!
Noah's Weavings arrived at that exact moment, surrounding and bombarding the two Dead Things with countless crimson threads of brilliance that sought to break down their weavings.
But it wasn't just that.
"What...the hell?"
The Dead Things were utterly shocked. Not by the power—the complexity felt surprisingly manageable.
No. What shocked them was that the threads were unbinding and devouring trace amounts of their Dead True Sources.
A being with a Living True Source of Existence was devouring fragments of their Dead True Sources?
They were stupefied. Because they knew how corrupted their Dead True Sources were.
Even if dispersed, they always returned. Parasitic weavings that never left.
Yet...
The crimson threads of Ruination did break down the fragments. And then... devoured them.

Their eyes watched in disbelief as dark gray threads of death and decimation flowed through crimson lines—until they were absorbed into the dazzling white-gold object spinning in the chest of a distant being.
They looked at him like he'd lost his mind. As if they wanted to say, "Dude, are you okay? Eating our weavings will kill you, you know?"
Even the Origin Singed turned in that moment—gaze sharp, expression unreadable—as multiple Pillars of Concordance of the Singed burst outward.
A grandiose battle began.
Shockingly, a Cradle of Purity was being wielded as a weapon!
This battle, unfolding in the Frequency of Light, had Noah facing down two Dead Things alongside the Origin Singed, even as the fallout of his past mistakes reverberated across existence.
His gaze soured as he looked up, vision crossing countless weavings until it landed on the Infinite Ravines.
BOOM!
The Great Beyonder, Veyl'Aethra, and Noah were unleashing their True Sources of Existence to withstand the arrival of the Dead Things. And shockingly, the situation wasn't completely dire.
Thanks to Noah.

His white-gold flames emanating from the True Source of the Singed had empowered the True Sources of both Veyl'Aethra and the Great Beyonder, allowing them to release more than double their usual complexity.
Fiery Pillars of Concordance blazed across the battlefield, stabilizing their Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexities.
But just as the trio might've found reason to breathe...
Noah sighed.
He looked up first. He had expected this.
"It seems," he muttered, "that things are about to get a little more dreadful... because of someone's stupid mistake."
Veyl'Aethra and the Great Beyonder followed his gaze, stunned.
A space equivalent to an entire omniverse away fractured, collapsing—as if something else was being layered atop it.
Another Domus was being merged.
The Great Beyonder gawked, shaking her head in disbelief.
"You absolutely cannot be serious, right?"
It wasn't even directed at Noah.
It was like she was asking the Wheel of Existence itself...
"Really? Really???"
Because what was happening was utterly maddening.
Noah looked on, voicing it calmly.
"The Origin Singed left his post to protect the True Frequency of the Singed—even after I told him not to. His return to the Wheel has pulled in two more Dead Things...in addition to Bob."
His words only brought worse news.
The others' expressions darkened, but Noah continued.

"Bob is contained. The other two are being held off too. The merging Domus is likely what the Origin Singed left behind. But to withstand it and the Dead Things within...it's going to take far more complexity."
His eyes burned with quiet brilliance, contemplating countless possibilities.
His True Source of the Singed had incredible empowering potential, but the way he was using it... barely tapped even five percent of its capabilities.
His thoughts raced.
How much change could he unleash in a span of an instant?
He turned to the Great Beyonder as many possibilities came together at once, and he came to a decision.

"I...may have a method to boost your current complexity by a tremendous degree in a short time. The environment here isn't ideal, so I'll do it through your Trace Weavings of Existence in the Amarantos Dream under the Wheel of Existence."
He said it like it was simple.
The Great Beyonder looked at him, utterly dumbfounded.
But Noah? He was already continuing the conversation somewhere else entirely.
All of it contained in the span of a moment.
The span...of an instant.
Within an Amarantos Dream.

Atop a surreal landscape of obsidian-gold mountains and floating clouds, Noah stood, eyes fixed on Azzurra—now hosting the fully assimilated consciousness of the Great Beyonder as his voice echoed out to her.

"You mentioned two methods of increasing complexity: the Mechanic of Ascension via Existential Source Trials, and the Mechanic of Ascension via Source Devouring Evolution. I...I am creating a third Mechanic of Ascension right now."
As if it were that simple.
Right now.
The Great Beyonder just stared at him, completely incredulous!

chapters.title: Chapter 3671: Ashes VI
paragraphs: A different Mechanic of Ascension- one unlike the Existential Source Trials or the Mechanism of Ascension via Source Devouring Evolution.

Noah said this with utter seriousness. The Great Beyonder could already guess what he meant by his earlier words about the Gateway Domus not being a suitable place to use this new method. But here, in this Amarantos Dream, it was possible.
She had a suspicion about what it could be as she asked with sharp eyes just to make sure.
"You...aren't a Fractal Being with a tendency toward things like this, right?"
Noah didn't even bother responding. Around his body, multiple Sources flared to life.
Traces of the Singed.
Vibrant waves of the True Source of Existence.
Ecstatic pulses of the True Source of Ruination.
But the Singed was the critical one. The other two only amplified it, empowering what had been locked down in the Infinite Ravines.
The Great Beyonder stared at the radiant True Sources with marvel, confirming Noah's earlier claim- he truly held multiple True Sources.
And then he spoke, white-gold flames of the Singed dancing across his skin.

"One can either undergo trials and battering to gradually strengthen their True Source, or devour the Purity and Complexity of others at the cost of becoming a Fractal Being. But the mechanism I'm about to forge... I call it Eclipse Merging—Dual Evolution."
WAA!
Eclipse Merging—Dual Evolution!
Noah spoke the term aloud as his body radiated an overwhelming purity without a hint of complexity.
Only Purity.
The Singed, brimming with Purity, seemed to isolate that essence from all the other Sources within him.

"Pioneered by the True Source of the Singed, all of the Purity of my Existence is brought to the forefront. Eclipse Merging resonates with another True Source- not merely empowering it, but merging and sharing the Purity of its Existence. This merging allows for potential Evolution in both True Sources. The greatest requirement is absolute trust, as the flames of the Singed... must be allowed to flow into another's True Source."
As he finished, he extended his hand.
The Great Beyonder rolled her eyes as she placed hers into his.
She wanted to say this was just dual cultivation with extra steps- but she went along with it.
White-gold brilliance surged around them, clothes falling away in a flare of light. A veil descended around them. Bodies entwined. Pure flames of the Singed bloomed around them, dazzling and heavy!
And the Great Beyonder closed her eyes and felt it.
Her True Source, still bound within the Infinite Ravines, sparked to life.
More than when the Singed had once washed her and Veyl'Aethra in its power as this time, it wasn't just empowering her.
This time, the Singed flowed into her True Source.
She hesitated.

It was dangerous- deadly, even. To let someone into your True Source was to hand them your existence. If she didn't resist, if she didn't defend it, he could shatter her very foundation if he so chose.
She hesitated.
And as if sensing her fear, Noah pulled her closer. She bit her lip, and her eyes glimmered with unshakable resolve. And then, she allowed her True Source to fully open.
Countless trillions of swirling obsidian runes became bathed in the flames of the Singed-those flames now flowing into every rune, altering them to gold.
Resonance. Then, for a moment, true merging.
It was otherwise impossible to merge two True Sources.
But the terrifying purity of the Singed allowed it. It could merge with another Source seamlessly, refining and purifying it to terrifying levels- temporarily anyways!
The Great Beyonder trembled as her Purity shot upward rapidly.
And then...
The Singed took in the Purity of both the True Sources of Ruination and Existence, channeling crimson and obsidian flames into her very essence as...
BOOM!
Her body erupted with dozens of glimmering Pillars of Concordance.
Glimmering pillars that represented her skyrocketing Purity- her very Existence elevated as waves of complexity fed back into her main body in the Infinite Ravines.
Noah's voice came softly like a law written into existence.
"Not just an Empowerment or Resonance...but an Evolution of the True Source as it's influenced by the Purity of another."
The Purity of the Great Beyonder's True Source surged, her eyes snapping open in disbelief.
She could feel her Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity brushing up against a wall- one she'd never thought she could cross so soon.
Her Complexity remained at the same stage.
But her Purity, spurred by Noah's method, began to exceed it.
And then it happened.
She felt it.
She felt her Purity eclipse the Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity as she spoke, dazed.

"Past the Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity... one's Complexity and Purity begin to form their Mythic True Signature. From there, they become one of two things- a Converged Architect with High Complexity and Moderate Purity...or a Resplendent Monad with Moderate Complexity and High Purity."
The stages of power among True Source entities.
Nascent Source-Bearer Complexity.
Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity.
And then...the divergence.
If one had High Purity and Moderate Complexity, they became a Resplendent Monad.
If they had High Complexity and Moderate Purity, they became a Converged Architect.
And at this very moment, the Great Beyonder's Purity rose so fast that her Mythic True Signature began to form.
Genuinely. Slowly!
"I... I should barelt qualify as a Quasi-Resplendent Monad with this much Purity..."
She stared at the surreal truth.
Noah listened, the flames of the Singed rising higher around them both. He asked, his voice calm but curious.
"Any changes to the nature of your True Source?"
His weavings moved through her True Source of Runes- swimming in them.
She had trusted him fully.

And as his Singed weavings permeated through her True Source of Runes, his Pathway to the True Source of Runes rapidly took shape as the road was built seamlessly- with him very soon attaining this True Source himself while the Purity of the Singed...became even grander!
His flames were everywhere inside her.
He could feel it.
He could sense the forming of the so called Mythic True Signature the Great Beyonder had spoken of. Her voice came to him softly as she tried to understand the purity surging within her.

"My Runes are purer, their existence deeper, and they now carry heat. A scorching, unfathomable heat. As a Quasi-Resplendent Monad...my Mythic True Signature will be capable of suppressing any Harmonized Sourcebound Icon!"
HUUM!
She said it with awe and barely veiled hunger.
Her terrifying Purity flowed back to her main body in the Infinite Ravines.
She didn't just want to stabilize the current chaos.
She wanted to burn away the Dead Things.
She wanted to kill!

chapters.title: Chapter 3672: Ashes VII
paragraphs: Nascent Source-Bearer Complexity, Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity... and then, Converged Architect or Resplendent Monad.
Levels that correlated low to average degrees of Complexity and Purity... to moderate levels... and then to heights of High Purity and Complexity.
The Great Beyonder had just taken her first steps into the realm of a Resplendent Monad-forming what she now called a Mythic True Signature.
But... what did that truly mean when observing the True Sources of the living and the dead?
In the Infinite Ravines.
Inside a Gateway Domus that held... ten Wild True Sources of Existence.
Ten Wild True Sources.
That meant nine other Gateway Domus had collapsed and been merged into this single one. Such a place should have been impossible to hold and terrifying in its Complexity and power.
It begged the question- who could possibly be standing at its forefront to defend it?

Across the inestimable waves of warped distance, the auras of more than twenty Dead Things sprawled throughout the chaotic Domus, this entire structure swirling with fractured color and brilliance as the Wild True Sources seethed, ebbed, and flowed all around.
There were crystal mountains in one direction. Layers of fiery, hellish landscapes in another.
Seas of silver and gold shimmered to one side. The skies in another blazed with purple flames.

The mere expression of ten Wild True Sources would be enough to cause any Nascent Source-Bearer to falter and collapse, even. But here, in these volatile weavings of existence, every single entity present was a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon.
Well... almost every entity.
One would expect countless defenders stationed at a Gateway Domus holding ten Wild True Sources.
But there was only one.
A single figure who stood alone against more than twenty Dead Things.

At this moment, a middle-aged man with dark hair and sun-warmed skin hovered above a gray sea of ash. His figure was wrapped in a billowing robe of smoke and shadow, his entire presence emanating a serene, unshakable grace.
He appeared... relaxed.
As if the chaos didn't exist.

He floated lazily in the sea of gray-ash brilliance, utterly absorbed in the Senet board before him. He didn't even glance toward the monstrous Dead Things moving slowly, devouring and surviving within this terrifyingly converged Domus.
Above this man, seated calmly upon the gray ash sea, were over a hundred glowing Pillars of Concordance- shimmering structures designated to various points across the Domus.
Each pillar released waves of unending gray ash, carrying a sense of absolute finality.
A memory of what once was.
It felt like... if even a single fleck of that ash touched one's True Source, that Source would begin to collapse- transformed into nothing more than what the ash represented.
Untold ruin. Irrevocable destruction.
The many gray ash pillars stretched in every direction, creating a stabilizing force that hindered the Dead Things' movements.
But even they weren't the true reason for the terrifying stability of this space.
Above the ash-draped man playing Senet, an illusory figure shimmered brilliantly in the skies.
An enormous figure—gray and luminous—hovered high above, and it looked exactly like the man seated in the sea below.
But this illusion... was colossal.
Larger than even ten Omniverses combined.
Compared to his true two-meter frame floating calmly on the ashen tide, the contrast was almost absurd.
And yet, the massive being projected above wasn't just a visual trick.
It was his Mythic True Signature of Existence.
So vibrant. So vastly complex.
Its eyes alone were the size of entire Omnverses, and they gazed coldly and unforgivingly at every single Dead Thing present.
The moment any of them dared to move...
That would be their death.
There would be collapse. There would be ash.
This was the terrifying True Source of Asche, and it wrapped itself around a single man.
Still focused on his board, he smiled faintly and spoke, seemingly to no one.
"Hey... I'm hearing a different tune of existence after all these millions of years. Sounds like something's coming."
He spoke, but there was nobody around him!
And yet, right after...
He nodded, as though receiving a reply from someone or something only he could hear.
His head tilted toward a shifting reflection forming in the gray sea.
It showed a different Gateway Domus, one from elsewhere in the Infinite Ravines.
Multiple such reflections rippled around him- screens showing other Domus, many of them trembling, merging with one another in real time.
The man bearing the True Source of Asche gazed into them all. Then sighed.
"Take it easy on these kids. If any more doors need merging, just bring them here. And... oh?"
He paused.
One of the reflections caught his attention—the fourth door he recognized clearly.
His brows lifted.
"That's the door of the Little Singed... why did he abandon it? And you're merging it into..."
His eyes lit with sharp brilliance.
He leaned closer.
"That's..." he muttered, entranced as he watched an obsidian-gold Signature bloom above a certain Great Beyonder.
"What a pleasant surprise... another Mythic True Signature on the rise. That'll ease a few burdens."
He paused.
"But... much more will be needed if the tune I'm hearing turns out to be real. I'll need to step in just a bit more."
As he said it, his seated form began to rise slowly from the gray ash sea.
Immediately, the Dead Things stirred.
Their auras flared. Their Dead True Sources of Existence surged outward in response.
But before they could act, the man wrapped in the True Source of Asche tapped a single finger toward one of them.
A creature shaped like a million-legged insect, its body jagged and grotesque, shrieked and flew backward in terror.
And yet...
With that one tap...
A Signature, an identity of a very profound existence flickered!
And the ash came.
A wave of swirling gray- final and unfathomable, wrapped the creature in a sea of ruin.
Even as its Dead True Source screamed in defiance, its body and being destabilized, breaking down...
Until it became ash.
Within a second, a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity-level Dead Thing was reduced to flickering dust.
All other Dead Things paused mid-devouring.
They roared, not in triumph, but in dread.
And the one bearing the True Source of Asche narrowed his gaze, his voice cutting through the chaos.
"You've eaten up so much... stay behind for me."
WAA!
He had killed more Dead Things than he could remember over the eons.
And now...
He was simply adding to his tally.

sentences.text: Nascent Source-Bearer Complexity, Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity... and then, Converged Architect or Resplendent Monad.
Levels that correlated low to average degrees of Complexity and Purity... to moderate levels... and then to heights of High Purity and Complexity.
The Great Beyonder had just taken her first steps into the realm of a Resplendent Monad-forming what she now called a Mythic True Signature.
But... what did that truly mean when observing the True Sources of the living and the dead?
In the Infinite Ravines.
Inside a Gateway Domus that held... ten Wild True Sources of Existence.
Ten Wild True Sources.
That meant nine other Gateway Domus had collapsed and been merged into this single one.
Such a place should have been impossible to hold and terrifying in its Complexity and power.
It begged the question- who could possibly be standing at its forefront to defend it?

Across the inestimable waves of warped distance, the auras of more than twenty Dead Things sprawled throughout the chaotic Domus, this entire structure swirling with fractured color and brilliance as the Wild True Sources seethed, ebbed, and flowed all around.
There were crystal mountains in one direction.
Layers of fiery, hellish landscapes in another.
Seas of silver and gold shimmered to one side.
The skies in another blazed with purple flames.
The mere expression of ten Wild True Sources would be enough to cause any Nascent Source-Bearer to falter and collapse, even.
But here, in these volatile weavings of existence, every single entity present was a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon.
Well... almost every entity.
One would expect countless defenders stationed at a Gateway Domus holding ten Wild True Sources.
But there was only one.
A single figure who stood alone against more than twenty Dead Things.
At this moment, a middle-aged man with dark hair and sun-warmed skin hovered above a gray sea of ash.
His figure was wrapped in a billowing robe of smoke and shadow, his entire presence emanating a serene, unshakable grace.
He appeared... relaxed.
As if the chaos didn't exist.
He floated lazily in the sea of gray-ash brilliance, utterly absorbed in the Senet board before him.
He didn't even glance toward the monstrous Dead Things moving slowly, devouring and surviving within this terrifyingly converged Domus.
Above this man, seated calmly upon the gray ash sea, were over a hundred glowing Pillars of Concordance- shimmering structures designated to various points across the Domus.
Each pillar released waves of unending gray ash, carrying a sense of absolute finality.
A memory of what once was.
It felt like... if even a single fleck of that ash touched one's True Source, that Source would begin to collapse- transformed into nothing more than what the ash represented.
Untold ruin.
Irrevocable destruction.
The many gray ash pillars stretched in every direction, creating a stabilizing force that hindered the Dead Things' movements.
But even they weren't the true reason for the terrifying stability of this space.
Above the ash-draped man playing Senet, an illusory figure shimmered brilliantly in the skies.
An enormous figure—gray and luminous—hovered high above, and it looked exactly like the man seated in the sea below.
But this illusion... was colossal.
Larger than even ten Omniverses combined.
Compared to his true two-meter frame floating calmly on the ashen tide, the contrast was almost absurd.
And yet, the massive being projected above wasn't just a visual trick.
It was his Mythic True Signature of Existence.
So vibrant.
So vastly complex.
Its eyes alone were the size of entire Omnverses, and they gazed coldly and unforgivingly at every single Dead Thing present.
The moment any of them dared to move...
That would be their death.
There would be collapse.
There would be ash.
This was the terrifying True Source of Asche, and it wrapped itself around a single man.
Still focused on his board, he smiled faintly and spoke, seemingly to no one.
"Hey...
I'm hearing a different tune of existence after all these millions of years.
Sounds like something's coming."
He spoke, but there was nobody around him!
And yet, right after...
He nodded, as though receiving a reply from someone or something only he could hear.
His head tilted toward a shifting reflection forming in the gray sea.
It showed a different Gateway Domus, one from elsewhere in the Infinite Ravines.
Multiple such reflections rippled around him- screens showing other Domus, many of them trembling, merging with one another in real time.
The man bearing the True Source of Asche gazed into them all.
Then sighed.
"Take it easy on these kids.
If any more doors need merging, just bring them here.
And... oh?"
He paused.
One of the reflections caught his attention—the fourth door he recognized clearly.
His brows lifted.
"That's the door of the Little Singed... why did he abandon it?
And you're merging it into..."
His eyes lit with sharp brilliance.
He leaned closer.
"That's..." he muttered, entranced as he watched an obsidian-gold Signature bloom above a certain Great Beyonder.
"What a pleasant surprise... another Mythic True Signature on the rise.
That'll ease a few burdens."

I'll need to step in just a bit more."

chapters.title: Chapter 3673: Point of No Return I
paragraphs: Inside a Gateway Domus swirling with ten Wild True Sources, the holder of the True Source of Asche began wiping out the Dead Things he had drawn in over the years.
They arrived at the doorways and would see his figure, knowing he was too powerful for them to attack and overcome.
But since he never attacked, and they could remain inside the Domus to devour Wild True Sources constantly... they stayed and did so.
Carefully.
Or so they believed.

But their time was limited- they were simply lambs being led to slaughter. And now, the slaughter had begun as seas of ash swirled around the Dead Things, breaking down their True Sources in terrifying ways because even that which was dead... turned to ash.
As this occurred in one Gateway Domus...
In another, a Wild True Source of Oxidation descended from above, coming to layer itself upon the Wild True Sources of Verbum, Fear, and Causality.

Wherever this True Source passed, existence degraded. Corrosion swept through anything that was or could be as if any weak True Source of Existence came close, it would rust and decay unfathomably fast.
It was a terrifying True Source to encounter, and it made its descent into the same Gateway Domus that Noah, the Great Beyonder, and Veyl'Aethra occupied.
Its arrival drew the raging auras of three Dead Things, howling with the kind of baleful fury only those who missed something vital could emit.
They had missed their chance to enter the genuine wheel of existence.
Because the protector of the previous Domus had returned to the folds of the wheel itself, and two "lucky" Dead Things had managed to follow the Origin Singed down that path.
But these three had not.
So they came now- late, furious, and full of spite as Noah and the Great Beyonder looked at each other.

In a distant place, their weavings intertwined as Noah continued Eclipse Merging—Dual Evolution. Their Purity surged, and the Great Beyonder pushed herself to stabilize at the threshold of a Quasi-Resplendent Monad.
And at that moment- she chose to reveal it.
She asked herself- What does it mean to step into the stage of a Quasi-Resplendent Monad?
The answer was Purity.
When the Purity of one's True Source reached a certain threshold, it shone with terrifying radiance. Deep within her, her identity crystallized into a singular emblem.
A Mythic True Signature formed entirely from her True Source of Runes.
It was as if she had crafted a second self, born of incomprehensible purity. And though it remained within her...
"Come out."
She spoke with quiet command, her eyes flashing. From the depths of her being, a dazzling, illusory obsidian-gold form erupted.
It was massive- so immense that its conceptual size dwarfed understanding.
A manifestation of her identity- an illusory titan made of black-gold light hovered above her, expanding to the length of an entire Omniverse.
Next to it, her physical body seemed insignificant.
But her Mythic True Signature...was everything!
And perhaps the most astonishing part- she barely needed to exert any Authority to manifest it.
Her signature was no different than a human smiling or waving. Just a natural expression of who she was.
So the Great Beyonder let it shine.

The massive signature towered above her, taking the form of a dark-haired woman whose presence radiated unfathomable beauty and power. She gazed down upon the three oncoming Dead Things, who raged and roared, throwing out their True Sources in blind fury.

But the Great Beyonder's Mythic True Signature opened its mouth and dominance rolled out like a storm. Quintillions of Runes erupted like a beam of reality-shattering light, slamming toward all three Dead Things.
BOOM!
The Dead Things recoiled.
The Mythic Signature had formed so quickly, they couldn't dodge it. The obsidian pillar of brilliance consumed them near-instantly.
Their Dead True Sources screamed like fresh flesh sizzling in boiling oil.
Collapse surged through them.
Quintillions of Runes pierced their True Sources, unraveling everything that made them them.
And within those Runes...was heat.
The heat of Flames.
Eclipse Merging.
Dual Evolution.
The design of the True Severed Origin Osmontian wasn't just a dual cultivation method. It was a way to evolve True Sources and to transform their very essence. To evolve them!
And now, the Beyonder's True Source of Runes displayed a new quality.
It roared with a penetrating glare, cutting through all three Dead Things simultaneously. It was about to cleave them in half...until a voice stopped it.
"Leave a shred of their Source intact. I have uses for them..."
Noah's voice rang out with calm finality. The Great Beyonder's eyes flashed as she commanded her Mythic Signature to obey.
It cleaved their bodies, leaving them split in half- just enough of their True Sources still pulsing in the distance.
The terrifying pillar of Runes remained as from within it, a single Rune pulsed white-gold and ignited, shaping into the figure of Noah.

He had warped across the span of an entire Omniverse to appear beside the three decimated Dead Things. His chest radiated as three white-gold tendrils burst out, wrapping around their crumbling forms and dragging them into his chest.
Their Dead True Sources had no resistance left. They'd been shredded by the storm of Runes, nearly collapsing into oblivion.
So from Noah, the Cradle of Purity emerged- its tendrils searing with light. They coiled around the Dead Things like celestial chains and yanked them into his chest.
Then...they vanished.
It took a a while to describe.

But in reality, everything had occurred in a single second- from the Great Beyonder's signature unveiling that released a magnificent Mythic True Signature, to Noah's sudden appearance near the decimated Dead Things, to the moment the three Dead Things were dragged into his chest into the Cradle of Purity!
One second.
And the collapse of three Dead Things was complete.
Silence followed.
A crushing, awe-filled stillness blanketed the Gateway Domus as Veyl'Aethra- and even the other Dead Things still exerting their power around the Wild True Sources- froze and stared!

chapters.title: Chapter 3674: Point of No Return II
paragraphs: Three Dead Things- cleared in a second.
And these particular three weren't just any Dead Things. They came from a new Gateway, seething with rage- rage that stemmed from missing their chance to enter the folds of the Wheel of Existence.
But all of that fury?
It meant absolutely nothing when their Dead True Sources collapsed instantly!
Veyl'Aethra stared up, stunned, eyes locked on the impossibly massive Mythic True Signature swirling above them.
"That... how did you manage to achieve that?"

His voice was dazed. So were his weavings. He knew the kind of power the Great Beyonder commanded- but he had no explanation for how she had gone from releasing Pillars of Concordance... to a Mythic True Signature.

The Great Beyonder's face didn't so much as flinch. Her gaze was fixed on Noah- the distant figure who had just absorbed three Dead Things into his chest like it was the most natural thing in the world.
She couldn't explain exactly what she had done- or what she was still doing, hidden within the privacy of an Amarantos Dream deep in the Weavings of the Wheel.
But her eyes carried a sharpness. A caution.
A message pulsed outward to Noah.
"You've revealed so many different things in such a short time that maybe I don't even need to ask. But... did you really just draw in the remnants of the Dead True Sources of those three?"
Her voice was calm, but edged in disbelief.
"Life and death don't mix. I've heard of many who've faced Fractal Collapse just for trying to devour incompatible Wild True Sources—much less Dead Things. But you already know that."
She said it because she had to. Because no matter how much she believed in the power of the one who had opened up new pathways of power, what he was doing defied reason.
And if he didn't speak up before doing things like this, it could come off as nothing short of absurd.
She didn't wait for his reply. After all they'd shared, she already knew the answer.
"You're not going to tell me that what happens to others- collapse, corruption, taint- won't apply to you, even though you just devoured the remnants of three Dead True Sources of Existence, right?"
She said it anyway.
And from the distance, Noah's only reply was a smile.
The Great Beyonder sighed as silence hung between them. Then, her Mythic True Signature turned toward the other Dead Things still prowling their Gateway Domus.
"Since someone unfathomable and impossible to understand has arrived... it's time this Gateway was cleared of all Dead Things that have been plaguing it for far too long."
Her Mythic True Signature glared down with glacial resolve and brilliant cold fury.
No matter what their Dead True Sources represented.
No matter how many millions of years they had wandered across Infinite Ravines- or what lay beyond them.
In that moment, the Great Beyonder, newly ascended, struck to annihilate.
Meanwhile, the one who had set all of this in motion was facing wonders of his own, deep within the Weavings of Existence.
His main body was etching the final and most powerful System of Existence within the Ninth Mundi of Power.
Something else hadn't been planned, but it was happening as thanks to his design of a third Mechanic of Ascension through Eclipse Merging- Dual Evolution, he achieved something even faster.
|The Pathway to the True Source of Runes has been thoroughly walked and understood through the merging of true flames into the definition of Runes within the Great Beyonder.|
|Your own definition of Runes has been completed.|
|The True Source of Runes blooms to fruition.|
HUUM!
Who said Dual Cultivation held no power?
Who said one couldn't attain a True Source through it?
Well, there were many prerequisites. But Noah had met them. And in this moment, through a new companionship, he attained another True Source of Existence.
His Weavings burned anew, stepping forward in complexity once more.
And that wasn't all.
A newly born Affix began to bloom.
|Three Dead True Sources of Existence have been pulled into the Cradle of Purity.|
|The Dead True Sources are deemed Moderate in Complexity, and Below Average in Purity.|
|Refinement and Purification of the Three Dead True Sources has begun.|
The Cradle of Purity lit up with fantastical brilliance. And while this process unfolded, Noah was also devouring two more Dead True Sources- those he'd battled alongside the Origin Singed.
But there was one more his Weavings were reaching for.
A being far stronger than any Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Noah had faced.
This one was returning to power.
He was healing- regaining strength and edging closer and closer past Harmonized Sourcebound Icon.
His name was Bob!
Trapped in the True Frequency of the Singed, his body bound inside an endless prison of Ruination. Noah's tendrils had already pierced the prison's walls—nibbling at the brilliance of Khaos.
Bob's cold eyes turned toward them.

He wasn't like other enemies- ones that could be overpowered and discarded easily in a single fight. Bob held the True Source of Khaos and, horrifyingly, an Absolute Complex True Source- even if it was a Dead one.
A black Wheel of Existence floated behind him.
His final card. His last move.

And if he used it to break free from this prison....he knew. Even Bob knew he would forfeit his right to fight for the depths of the Wheel of Existence where he believed an answer to where The Loom was existed!
His journey... would end.
The realization cut through him like truth. And Bob spoke.
"Many, many dangerous things happen...when someone's pushed to desperation."
His voice always had weight.
Even now, he made the norm feel unnatural and dangerous.

And as he spoke, obsidian stellar seas of the True Source of Existence intruded upon the prison of Ruination. Alongside them, a new True Source bloomed as billions of golden Runes exploded into reality.
Runes.
Gold and glorious.
Gold and resplendent.
Bob's eyes widened as the Runes crashed down around him. He understood once more that Noah was coming for everything- to devour and take everything he held!
All paths.
All exits.
And that... drove him to the edge of true desperation.

"You're pulling out True Sources from your arse like it's the easiest thing in the world," Bob voiced out. "More and more signs that this Wheel of Existence might actually be the one that holds that piece of the puzzle. And since I can't reach it, since you've pushed me this far...I can only say that whatever comes next...you engineered it. You made it possible."
Three True Sources of Existence clashed around him.

And at that moment, Bob's black Wheel of Existence materialized. His body overlapped with it, settling in its very core, tentacle-like limbs gripping the outer rims of the Dead Absolute Complex True Source.
He closed his eyes.
Tears fell.
And in a voice cracked with time and longing, he called out to a soul nestled within the Wheel.
"Wait just a little bit longer for Dad to get you, okay?"
A small soul stirred at the center of the Wheel, hearing a voice for the first time in millions of years.
And after that... incandescent brilliance erupted all around him.

"Many, many dangerous things happen...when someone's pushed to desperation."
His voice always had weight.
Even now, he made the norm feel unnatural and dangerous.
And as he spoke, obsidian stellar seas of the True Source of Existence intruded upon the prison of Ruination.
Alongside them, a new True Source bloomed as billions of golden Runes exploded into reality.
Runes.
Gold and glorious.
Gold and resplendent.
Bob's eyes widened as the Runes crashed down around him.
He understood once more that Noah was coming for everything- to devour and take everything he held!
All paths.
All exits.
And that... drove him to the edge of true desperation.
"You're pulling out True Sources from your arse like it's the easiest thing in the world," Bob voiced out.
"More and more signs that this Wheel of Existence might actually be the one that holds that piece of the puzzle.
And since I can't reach it, since you've pushed me this far...I can only say that whatever comes next...you engineered it.
You made it possible."
Three True Sources of Existence clashed around him.
And at that moment, Bob's black Wheel of Existence materialized.
His body overlapped with it, settling in its very core, tentacle-like limbs gripping the outer rims of the Dead Absolute Complex True Source.
He closed his eyes.
Tears fell.
And in a voice cracked with time and longing, he called out to a soul nestled within the Wheel.
"Wait just a little bit longer for Dad to get you, okay?"
A small soul stirred at the center of the Wheel, hearing a voice for the first time in millions of years.
And after that... incandescent brilliance erupted all around him.

chapters.title: Chapter 3675: Point of No Return III
paragraphs: With tears streaming from his eyes, Bob became transfused onto the black Wheel of Existence.
The Dead Absolute Complex True Source!

He sensed the terrifying complexity radiating from all around the bindings of the crimson prison. Apart from this True Source, he felt the stellar obsidian-black True Source that could revert existence, and now, a third True Source that displayed billions of golden runes.

"With every passing second, you grow stronger and stronger. A new True Source seems to bud from you as easily as breathing. My fate... is likely to face imprisonment and the gradual breakdown of my Existence with your increasing complexity. So let me take myself out of the equation."
Bob uttered these words as Noah moved even faster.
All of his True Sources held Average Complexity, with only his Purity surging at the Moderate level!
Against Bob, who had likely once surpassed the level of a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity before the collapse of his weavings...it wasn't enough to bring him down quickly.
Not against someone whose True Source of Khaos burned with a high level of complexity.
Not against someone who held a genuine Dead Absolute Complex True Source!

A black wheel, which he currently grasped by its rims, erupted with black brilliance that covered him entirely in its light. That same light pushed away Noah's billions of runes, seas of dark brilliance, and the crimson of Ruination!
"You have made me a desperate man, Noah Osmont."
WAA!
Bob's voice held no emotion or friendliness.
"And with desperation... comes pain on both sides. I know pain. I understand pain. I hope you are ready for it too... Friend. I will be back with the means necessary to obtain what I need."
Friend.
When he had said it before, multiple times, it carried a trace of weavings that it might have been true.
That he had considered it a possibility.

But at this moment, the word was unfathomably cold and filled with apathy. From the Black Wheel of Existence, Bob's figure became entirely bathed in black brilliance as he... disappeared from the endless prison of Ruination!
Khaos vanished, leaving behind faint remnants.
The glimmer of the Black Wheel of Existence remained as it flashed. Noah looked upon it with heaviness as he bellowed out.
"ECHOES OF THE UNWRITTEN!"
HUUM!
His seas of the True Source of Existence pulsed and seethed as he sought to undo an event!
But...
BZZT!
The Black Wheel of Existence, still present, spun heavily as it released waves of Complexity that resisted the reversal of this event!
"Echoes! Of! The! Unwritten!"
Noah's eyes shone with brilliance as he bellowed again, his True Source of Existence burning brightly, but the result was the same.
The first event he could not undo stood before him, with Bob having left behind a glimmer of the Black Wheel of Existence to prevent it.
And he called it a glimmer because with every passing second, the Dead Absolute Complex True Source of Existence became more and more illusory, as if it might fade at any moment.

Noah gazed at it with utter coldness. He despised the idea of an enemy escaping and prolonging conflict. He sought closure at every turn. But when it came to Bob- and the literal Absolute Complex True Source he wielded- what could be done?
He had come infinitely close to the core of the Wheel of Existence, closer than ever before. But even then, he couldn't reach it, not while Noah continued to display increasingly greater Complexity.
Unlike other maddened entities who would despair and go all out, Bob had done the rational thing- he left.
And he didn't just leave the True Frequency of the Singed.
He left the Wheel of Existence entirely.
Noah could confirm this with his current Complexity. When he tried to undo the event, he felt the push and pull leading toward the Infinite Ravines themselves!
He floated gloriously in the white-gold brilliance of the True Frequency of the Singed, his expression heavy.
True Sources swirled around him, but he felt no joy. This result could be considered both a success and a failure.
The threat of Bob was eliminated...
But only temporarily.
What would a man driven to desperation do to ensure that, when he returned, things would play out differently?
Especially one who understood Noah's rapid rate of progression, and knew the more time that passed, the stronger Noah would become, and the harder it would be to face him.
What would such an entity do to achieve his goals?
The possibilities were many.
And none of them were good!

Noah remained floating in the True Frequency of the Singed, his weavings continuing to press down on the illusory Black Wheel of Existence. Remnant tendrils of Khaos moved to devour anything they could, the Cradle of Purity buzzing softly at his chest.
But at this moment, only remnant weavings of Bob remained- everything else about him was gone!
This meant that now, only two Dead Things remained within the weavings of the Wheel. Noah's weavings, burning with frustration, turned fully upon them!
In the Frequency of Light.

The Gray-Wheeled Tentacled Dead Thing and the Heran Megalos Dead Thing were still facing the Pillars of Concordance of the Origin Singed, alongside countless tendrils of Ruination conducting Existential Unraveling.
But now, Noah's gaze carried a weight of livid determination as he called out coldly.
"Existential Engraving."
WAA!
Billions of golden runes unfurled from him, rushing toward the Two Dead Things already surrounded by multiple True Sources.
And unlike Bob, these Two Dead Things lacked the backing of an Absolute Complex True Source of Existence. So when the golden runes descended, they couldn't push them away so easily!
One golden rune after another became bound to their bodies while the tendrils of Ruination ran rampant, dividing their attention further.
Slowly, thousands of golden runes became branded into their bodies- their Weavings of Existence- as they became engraved!
Existential Engraving.
At that moment, Noah was beginning to understand that Runes were not just a language, but living codes.
Living, breathing codes of existence itself... and of what it could become.

chapters.title: Chapter 3676: Point of No Return IV
paragraphs: Codes of Existence.
Living, breathing weavings of Existence- that was how he saw Runes. And if he engraved his Runes of Existence onto the True Source of another...
He could rewrite their living code.
He could alter their living record.
Or, in the case of the Dead Things, their Dead Records.

When the Dead Things had thousands of Runes engraved across their bodies, they realized- too late- that the output of their True Sources was gradually being cut off. Their bodies could no longer express it freely.
Which gave the tendrils of Ruination more freedom to unravel their existence, as even more golden Runes latched onto their Dead True Sources.
When a million Runes were branded into their forms, more than half of their True Source output was severed.
"OOOH!"
They roared in maddened defiance, while opposite them, the figure of the Origin Singed watched Noah, his expression carved from stone.
Once over half of their True Sources were bound and suppressed, the unraveling through Ruination intensified. Their bodies were consumed—wrapped in countless crimson tendrils.
And then, hundreds of millions of golden Runes locked into their essence. Soon after, their Dead True Sources ceased all expression.
What they could express was no longer their own.
The Codes of Existence themselves bound to their essence, rewriting their very function-sealing their ability to even spread their weavings.
It was a horrifying act.
And as it took form, Noah floated toward the two bound Dead Things.
Their forms shimmered, incandescent golden Runes glowing across their surfaces, engraved deep into the framework of their existence.
He stood before them, eyes cold, hands clenched. The Runes binding them flickered and began to tear them apart.
Noah was literally ripping them to pieces.
He was furious.
He was livid!
"Give me your memories."
HUUM!
"Give me your records."
WAA!
"Give me everything."
He hadn't gotten what he needed from Bob.
So he took it out on these two.

And in doing so, he scattered their remnants into the Cradle of Purity, officially and personally destroying two Dead Things almost entirely by his own power as the wary Origin Singed floated nearby, gaze sharp.
Even then, his eyes flickered again. Changed and altered.
He looked inward.
And what he sensed stopped his weavings cold.
Something was devouring his True Source.
A sensation so vast and terrible that it should have been impossible not to notice—yet here it was, eclipsing over half his True Source before he even felt it.
This had been happening for some time.
Likely ever since...
Ever since his weavings of existence had been rewound. Healed.
When...!
His eyes flared with light. He looked at the back of the entity tearing the Dead Things apart.
One man. Against a half-shattered white Wheel of Existence sunken to his chest, nearly collapsed- had managed to reverse the unraveling.
But in that act of reversal, he had done something.
"What did you do to me?"
The Origin Singed's eyes burned as he shouted the question across the space between them.
What had Noah done?
Noah didn't turn. Didn't glance back at the flaming white-gold body of the being whose weavings he disapproved of. His reply came low and sharp.
"I did nothing. I simply didn't move to correct anything."

He had seen the Great Usurper's weavings within the Wheel- had seen him use Bob's necrotizing strike, the one that shattered an Absolute Complex True Source of Existence. A strike that should've ended someone like the Origin Singed.
And Noah...had simply let it happen.
He might have even helped.
Because...
"You don't seem to be using the True Source of the Singed well enough. Let someone else do it on your behalf."
His words, cold as the abyss, landed like blades.
The Origin Singed's face twisted, knowing over half of his weavings were no longer his own- commandeered by something else.
"The Wheel weaves as the Wheel weaves," he said stiffly, maintaining a hold on his composure. "But the Wheel will not stand for this."
A threat. Thinly veiled.
The Wheel would not allow one of its Protectors to be usurped.
But Noah never looked back. He kept ripping apart the weavings of two Dead Things.
His reply?
"What could you possibly know of what the Wheel wants... and doesn't want?"
HUUM!
With that, the body of the Origin Singed began to tremble.
Behind him, the illusion of a flickering white Wheel of Existence pulsed, then blinked in and out of view.
A moment passed.
Then his body went completely still.
Seconds later, his head rose.
His expression shifted.
And then...
A wide grin bloomed on his face.
"Holy shit."
The voice was not the Origin Singed's.
It belonged to someone else.
To the Great Usurper.
He lifted his hands, staring at them—at the vibrant True Source bubbling inside him. Then turned toward the shattered illusion of the white Wheel behind him.
And grinned wider.

"Even if it's broken," he said, awed, "the remnants of an Absolute Complex True Source are fantastic. I used a shred of their last authority to conduct the quickest and most thorough Subjugation of a Source."
His voice surged with power.
In mere moments, he had seized one of the mightiest True Source entities born of the Wheel—and made it his.
A radiant True Source, flickering with corruption and purity alike, danced across his fingertips. Remnants of a Dead Absolute Complex True Source still burned within his soul.
Noah finally turned, looking at his old friend.
His voice came calm.
"The living and the dead don't mix... so how do your weavings feel?"
The Great Usurper stood within the body of the Origin Singed, cloaked in dead souls from Bob's weavings. Bathed in the True Source of another.
He smiled.

"My existence remains living. And with these pure flames of the Origin Singed, I can purge all traces of Dead Sources. But..." he tilted his head slightly, eyes distant, "All weavings of Dead Things are calling to me now. I'm getting faster. More precise at usurping the souls of the Dead. It's like they're missing something vital—something that makes it easier for my weavings to spread. I think..."
He paused, then nodded.
"I think I'll chase more Dead Things. Head to the Infinite Ravines, where this guy just was. You good down here?"
The Great Usurper's path shimmered into existence before him.
And as Noah finished clearing the Wheel of Existence of all remaining Dead Things—the only ones that remained were already waiting... in the Infinite Ravines.

chapters.title: Chapter 3677: Point of No Return V
paragraphs: The living and the dead did not mix.
This statement seemed to be an absolute truth that remained staunch, and yet, as always- exceptions existed!

That which used to be the Origin Singed was struck by a half-shattered Dead Absolute Complex True Source, nearly causing his existence to collapse. But at that critical moment, the intervention of Noah and the weavings of the Great Usurper striking at the same time allowed something fantastical to be born.

The old Origin Singed, who had lived for millions of years, was no more. His pure flames were now under the control of the Great Usurper, who found a surprising connection and calling to the Dead Things.
The living was being drawn toward the dead, and for reasons unknown, it was unfathomably easier for him to expand his efforts of usurpation upon them than anyone else.
Noah looked at the figure of the Great Usurper as he acclimated to his new body and gave a light nod.
"No other Dead Things exist in these weavings of the wheel. At this moment, the only possible source of trouble remains the Infinite Ravines. Be careful there."
He offered the warning to his old friend, who smiled toward him and gave a light nod as his body began to burn with white-gold flames.

"To this day, I can never quite get a handle on the progression of power. When I took over the body of an Existence Severing entity, I looked at the very concept of existence they severed and thought to myself- wow, this is absolutely incredible. Then I took over a Pioneer, then a Lesser Source, a Greater Source, a Prime Source... every single one made me feel and see more. Now, I've got my hands on a True Source- someone at the Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity stage, apparently... and who knows what lies beyond this?"
The Great Usurper spoke with a smile full of melancholy, as if he was both expectant and cautious of what the future held.
Noah looked toward him, his calm weavings settling, as he replied.

"True Sources are the apex of complexity in existence, yet they are also stages filled with countless wonders. They rely on both the Purity and Complexity of Existence. You'll gain complexity fairly easily; the main issue is Purity. But you did take over the body of the Origin Singed- one of the purest existences due to his concept. So maybe you'll be okay in that field as well. For the Infinite Ravines- do you want to come to the same region where I am with a few others, or..."
Noah posed the question, but the Great Usurper shook his head vehemently.

"The same Gateway Domus as you? Not in a million years. I assume you'll clear it fairly soon—it might be empty of Dead Things right after. Ashmole had a point when he spoke about you and your Flow. It's far too massive...you absorb everything around you. Your Flow is bigger than mine as you're the one person I never wanted to compete against when it comes to resources. When there's an overabundance of them, I'll be there. And with the memories of the Origin Singed... what lies beyond the Infinite Ravines may be even more confounding, with countless opportunities waiting. But, one step at a time... one step at a time."
The Great Usurper made his decision. Noah nodded, watching as his old friend returned the gesture. His body began to flicker with a terrifying array of complexity as he took a step and disappeared.

"I'll keep in touch. And I'll keep looking for Bob. He completely isolated me in the White Wheel of Existence, which he then destroyed—as if he knew that, someday, he would need to do that to deal with me and multiple other issues. Among all the enemies we've faced... this one is different. He feels like us—like someone supported by the very weavings of reality and existence..."

The words of the Great Usurper resonated across the restoring frequency of light as Noah gave a light nod, watching as the weaving of his old friend vanished into the Weave and headed toward the Infinite Ravines.
Bob was like them.
This became more and more true over time. Of all the beings in his entire wheel-law of existence, Bob was the only one whose Flow exceeded all others.
A singular product of an entire Absolute Complex True Source.

Their first clash had ended, but he would return. When he did, Noah wanted to eliminate the sense of competition completely—to become so advanced in both Purity and Complexity of Existence that even if Bob was ten or a hundred times stronger than before, there would be ultimate closure by the time they met again.
He affirmed this silently as he examined his own existence.
The True Sources of the Singed, Existence, Ruination, and Runes burned within him.
Four True Sources of Existence!
Within his Cradle of Purity, he was drawing in multiple Dead Things, as they offered immense purity and complexity—resources he would soon allocate with purpose.
And his Last Mundi of Power... was nearly finished forming a new System of Existence. Once complete, his True Source Atlas of Existence would be whole.
There was much left to do, but he progressed steadily, ensuring the very weavings of existence around him didn't collapse.
Ruination would continue journeying across multiple frequencies of the wheel to obtain whatever shattered remnants and pieces remained—moving toward becoming a full Ruined Miniare Wheel of Existence.
If she could become an Absolute Complex True Source, it would mean another burst of complexity—ensuring Noah could handle any future battles effortlessly.
And then, there was the Infiniverse Megalos.
A wonder with complexity larger than any Frequency he had experienced so far—perhaps rivaled only by the true Frequency of the Singed.
Within this construct resided his family and his people.
Whenever he made tremendous leaps in complexity and power, they followed. At this moment, they had entire Frequencies of Existence as their playground.
It would be a time of preparation and of savoring the wonders that came with the complexity of existence as they readied themselves for whatever Bob or any other Dead Thing dared to throw their way.

sentences.text: The living and the dead did not mix.
This statement seemed to be an absolute truth that remained staunch, and yet, as always- exceptions existed!
That which used to be the Origin Singed was struck by a half-shattered Dead Absolute Complex True Source, nearly causing his existence to collapse.
But at that critical moment, the intervention of Noah and the weavings of the Great Usurper striking at the same time allowed something fantastical to be born.
The old Origin Singed, who had lived for millions of years, was no more.
His pure flames were now under the control of the Great Usurper, who found a surprising connection and calling to the Dead Things.
The living was being drawn toward the dead, and for reasons unknown, it was unfathomably easier for him to expand his efforts of usurpation upon them than anyone else.
Noah looked at the figure of the Great Usurper as he acclimated to his new body and gave a light nod.
"No other Dead Things exist in these weavings of the wheel.
At this moment, the only possible source of trouble remains the Infinite Ravines.
Be careful there."
He offered the warning to his old friend, who smiled toward him and gave a light nod as his body began to burn with white-gold flames.
"To this day, I can never quite get a handle on the progression of power.
When I took over the body of an Existence Severing entity, I looked at the very concept of existence they severed and thought to myself- wow, this is absolutely incredible.
Then I took over a Pioneer, then a Lesser Source, a Greater Source, a Prime Source... every single one made me feel and see more.
Now, I've got my hands on a True Source- someone at the Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity stage, apparently... and who knows what lies beyond this?"
The Great Usurper spoke with a smile full of melancholy, as if he was both expectant and cautious of what the future held.
Noah looked toward him, his calm weavings settling, as he replied.
"True Sources are the apex of complexity in existence, yet they are also stages filled with countless wonders.
They rely on both the Purity and Complexity of Existence.
You'll gain complexity fairly easily; the main issue is Purity.
But you did take over the body of the Origin Singed- one of the purest existences due to his concept.
So maybe you'll be okay in that field as well.
For the Infinite Ravines- do you want to come to the same region where I am with a few others, or..."
Noah posed the question, but the Great Usurper shook his head vehemently.
"The same Gateway Domus as you?
Not in a million years.
I assume you'll clear it fairly soon—it might be empty of Dead Things right after.
Ashmole had a point when he spoke about you and your Flow.
It's far too massive...you absorb everything around you.
Your Flow is bigger than mine as you're the one person I never wanted to compete against when it comes to resources.
When there's an overabundance of them, I'll be there.
And with the memories of the Origin Singed... what lies beyond the Infinite Ravines may be even more confounding, with countless opportunities waiting.
But, one step at a time... one step at a time."
The Great Usurper made his decision.
Noah nodded, watching as his old friend returned the gesture.
His body began to flicker with a terrifying array of complexity as he took a step and disappeared.
"I'll keep in touch.
And I'll keep looking for Bob.
He completely isolated me in the White Wheel of Existence, which he then destroyed—as if he knew that, someday, he would need to do that to deal with me and multiple other issues.
Among all the enemies we've faced... this one is different.
He feels like us—like someone supported by the very weavings of reality and existence..."

The words of the Great Usurper resonated across the restoring frequency of light as Noah gave a light nod, watching as the weaving of his old friend vanished into the Weave and headed toward the Infinite Ravines.
Bob was like them.
This became more and more true over time.
Of all the beings in his entire wheel-law of existence, Bob was the only one whose Flow exceeded all others.
A singular product of an entire Absolute Complex True Source.
Their first clash had ended, but he would return.

When he did, Noah wanted to eliminate the sense of competition completely—to become so advanced in both Purity and Complexity of Existence that even if Bob was ten or a hundred times stronger than before, there would be ultimate closure by the time they met again.
He affirmed this silently as he examined his own existence.
The True Sources of the Singed, Existence, Ruination, and Runes burned within him.
Four True Sources of Existence!
Within his Cradle of Purity, he was drawing in multiple Dead Things, as they offered immense purity and complexity—resources he would soon allocate with purpose.
And his Last Mundi of Power... was nearly finished forming a new System of Existence.
Once complete, his True Source Atlas of Existence would be whole.
There was much left to do, but he progressed steadily, ensuring the very weavings of existence around him didn't collapse.
Ruination would continue journeying across multiple frequencies of the wheel to obtain whatever shattered remnants and pieces remained—moving toward becoming a full Ruined Miniare Wheel of Existence.
If she could become an Absolute Complex True Source, it would mean another burst of complexity—ensuring Noah could handle any future battles effortlessly.
And then, there was the Infiniverse Megalos.
A wonder with complexity larger than any Frequency he had experienced so far—perhaps rivaled only by the true Frequency of the Singed.
Within this construct resided his family and his people.
Whenever he made tremendous leaps in complexity and power, they followed.
At this moment, they had entire Frequencies of Existence as their playground.
It would be a time of preparation and of savoring the wonders that came with the complexity of existence as they readied themselves for whatever Bob or any other Dead Thing dared to throw their way.

chapters.title: Chapter 3678: Point of No Return VI
paragraphs: One body of his finished up in the Frequency of Light.
Another body of his remained in the True Frequency of the Singed.
He looked at the necrotizing, shattered piece of a white Wheel of Existence that floated within his constraints and bindings as he surveyed this Frequency.
It no longer had its Origin Singed.
He looked at the many Singed who were gravely injured, as well as the figures of Emelline and Mysara.
They no longer had an Origin Singed to rely on at this moment, and Noah was all they had left.
Did that make him the True Origin Singed?
His gaze sharpened at such a weaving of an idea as he turned and looked toward the direction Bob had been trying so hard to reach.
Toward where the very core weavings of the Wheel of Existence should be!
As one man gazed over the endless weavings of the Wheel and what could possibly lie at their very center...
Across the endless Weave, where one could cross to enter countless Frequencies or step into the Infinite Ravines.
Within the Infinite Ravines themselves, inside a Gateway Domus filled with shattered mirrors reflecting absolutely nothing...
In here, the Omnifather could be seen sitting atop a fractured mirror, his form brilliantly massive and so vast that his sunken head alone had once been mistaken for a dying star.

His body was etched with ever-changing glyphs, ancient symbols of possible existences long collapsed. His flesh gleamed with multicolored brilliance- not like a rainbow, but like refracted stardust from a billion different parallel weavings of existence, constantly shifting in hue, tone, and density as if he were made from every plane of existence stitched together!
Yet... he looked truly worn.
Tired.

Sunken eyes, vast enough to hold the reflections of galaxies, stared downward, weighed by the burden of eons. His face was aged- wrinkled by gravity itself, time folding over it like paper too long exposed to the elements. His back was hunched, shoulders curled inward, as if the pressure of existence still rested upon them!
The Omnifather was the singular wielder of the True Source of Versality...was.

The Origin of variation, a source of infinite possibility and adaptation. Versality was the power to embody, merge, or reinterpret every other possibility out there. It had limitless fluidity. However, this blessing was also a curse. Versality never ceases. It shifts endlessly, pulling on him, draining him, never allowing rest, as even his existence must change. Thus, he appeared fractured and weary- a being endlessly rewriting himself, bearing the totality of all the possible forms he could be!
It was why, when he failed Existence Severing, he did not perish.
There were countless other possibilities of him that did not fail.
So he simply pulled upon them.
He made his mistakes.
A great deal of them, in fact.
His sunken eyes thought about the Dead Thing he had let in countless years ago, because he simply wanted to return into the weavings of the Wheel.
The Dead Thing...
HUUUM!
In his thoughts, the massive figure of the Omnifather was forced to raise his head as he felt the terrifying glow of a Dead Thing's complexity erupting across the Gateway Domus he protected!
And when he looked, he found this Dead Thing looking back at him.
Shooting across the Domus as if it were coming from the direction of... the Wheel of Existence itself.
As if it was leaving the Wheel of Existence, crossing the Gateway Domus, and heading out toward the Nullvein Gravewake Folds!
The Omnifather looked at the Dead Thing, his eyes trembling in incredulity and shock.

The Dead Thing—Bob—surrounded by a dazzling Dead Absolute Complex True Source of Existence, looked back at him. Their gazes locked briefly before Bob's cold, apathetic eyes turned away from the Omnifather, as if he had merely observed someone inconsequential.
But the Omnifather was shaken. That... was Bob!
A Watcher of the Wheelomachy. The Disciple of the First Watcher!
But he was a Dead Thing?
And as the Omnifather looked at the Black Wheel of Existence around Bob, he went ashen as he recognized that Wheel—it was the same one that had wrapped around a tentacled creature...
A Dead Thing he had once let into the Wheel and hunted down himself to kill and eradicate, as it had ruined his tremendous Purity and prevented him from becoming a Resplendent Monad!
But... they were one and the same?
And now it was leaving the Wheel of Existence?!
The more the Omnifather thought about it, the more ashen he became as he imagined disastrous consequences!
"STOP!"

He roared, his billowing True Source of Versality erupting, but the blinding black brilliance covering Bob was far too intricate and complex. Bob did not even glance behind him as he continued to tear across the Gateway Domus until he flickered out of existence!
The Omnifather breathed heavily as he stared at the scene.
His eyes pulsed with lividity and rage as he roared, his body splitting apart as one of him surged ahead.
Following where Bob had vanished—into the Nullvein Gravewake Folds, where rare were the entities of the Wheel of Existence who dared to go...
Unless they had abandoned their posts.
Past a Gateway Domus.
And into the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
BOOM!

The unmaking of existence thundered out as the figure of Bob crossed a doorway and made a clean exit—appearing in an area filled with overlapping folds of existence and non-existence stretching out endlessly in all directions!
From where he came, one could barely make out a flicker of life amid all the death.

It looked like a shattered mirror barely discernible amidst the obsidian folds of collapse, paradox, and fragmented existence—hidden between the folds of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds, where the entrance to the Gateway Domus he had just exited lay!

The moment he arrived in the Nullvein Gravewake Folds, his body began to brim with a terrifying sense of Complexity as if unshackled. Black and white brilliance erupted from the Absolute Complex True Source of Existence that bathed over Bob, and in the next moment...
WAP!
Black and white separated.
In the Nullvein Gravewake Folds, two Bobs- one white, one black—appeared.
The White Bob looked weary and tired, while the Black Bob met his eyes with a cold gaze, his voice echoing out.
"You tried things your way for millions of years, and look where that brought us."
The Black Bob shone with interminable luminosity.
His Complexity was rising ever higher, while his Purity remained constant. His voice echoed, resonating with the weavings of collapse all around.
"I'll take it from here."
WAA!
